ljulgon 'ar+bhe9) gtam/lha cis rig shes bya kun gsal skal bzang dge legs 'dren pa'i legs bshad phyogs las nam rgyal zhes bya ba 'di 'bri rtsom byed pa po ni gnyer stag gam snang rgyal4ti shes rab nyi ma smradabang rig pa'i 'dod 'jo mchogayin la/ khong ni spyi lo 964lor ngasal phyug mo'i grong khyer du skyes shing / mkhas mnga'adus pa'i ste gnas snang zhig dgone chenadu bka' drin sum ldan gyi bla mdam pa'i zhal snga nas/bgrang pho dgu'i thog rabatu byung ste mkhas btsun bzang gsumadang ldan pa'i dge bshes tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dang khong gi khu bo nam mkha' zung gi mdun nasayi ge 'bri klog sogs legs par sbyangs shingan gzhung brgya'i dbang phyug ma hā panyi ta shes rab blo ldan mchog dngan mtsho byung dga' ba'i khro khros/ dbyangs can sgeg pa'i tho ldan/ṅgārma'i mtshan can sogs mkhasadabang mang tho'i zhabs dul spyi bor bstenate/sum rtagasadag gsum/ snyan ngag dang mngon brjod/ skar nag gi rtsis/ ka tsan dbyangs gsum/ ldib spyor dang sgos gar/ yig rigs du ma'i thig tshad/ shing par brko tshul sogs kyi man ngag gi bdu da ci'i thegs ma dgosadagu ru smin zhing lo grangs bcu gsum nas so gcig bar slob grwa che chung khagatangagadapal ldan sman ri'i dgon chen/ dge ldan bkra shis 'khyil sogs la phyin nas/ mdo ljags rdzogs gsum la slong brdol ba dpon slob bstan 'dzin rnam dag dang gnas don bcu la dbang 'byor ba lha rams pa gtsang thub bstan rin chen/ brtson 'grus gong 'phel/ dge legasaphun tshogab/ yogs bshes gnyen mang tho'i zhal snga nas/ bsdus grwa dang nam 'grel/ dbu phar dul pa/de lngags rnyo gas la nyin mtshan sbrel nas brtson pa ches cher byas mthar/ gyi garadang b.lasal rmyo gas lalozhe pa'ithobakyidagon sdeltog dang slob grwa 5gesalozheto ༄zhe la ka shāya/thode kyi rigagazhung 'gran bakhrur babyi ga ba kyi za 'dzam gling bla ma mchogagis kyang bsngagasadabyangasadang bcagayang r+shar phyin pa) tags mtshag du rlabs chen gyis byadaga'ayangadag bstsal/khonganagazhinadusasgas rnamadarjo/de pyi sgo'aphar mchogatayangang/

dkar chag1) sngon57 gtam/2) mar bsgo/ga) slo rig shes bya kun gsal las ljonabs skabs /) rab/spya byed pa ste dang 11 bzhu/gas/ (4)4) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las ljon 'phri skabs /) rab/tu byed pa ste ga2)sa pa bsdogabaskyas/ (6)5) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las skyes rtsis kyi rabatu byed pa'i skabasate gsum pa bzhugs/ (15) 6) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las bag rtsis kyi rabatu byed pa'i skabasate bzhi ba bzhugs/ (22) 7) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las nad rtsis kyi rabatu byed pa'i skabasate lnga ba bzhugs/ (36)8) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las kun rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te drug pa bzhugs/ (49)9) cis rig shes bya ku/na gsal las keg rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te bdun pa bzhugs/ (52)

10) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las tshe rabs las rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te brgyad pa bzhugs glu glu glu glu glu ske — (61)11) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las bcu gsum lding 〈snar gyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te dgu ba bzhugs/ glu glu — —— —— glu glu —— ske ——— (88)12) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las shi rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te bcu ba bzhugs/ ske ske glu — —— (99)13) cis rig shes bya kun gsal las 'bras rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te bcu gcig pa bzhugs/ glu (111)

/ /na mo ci par ra gu dun spyan/stongabyu lha na maḥsarba dz+nyāḥya / bkra shis legs tshogs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpyidagu'akhrungasapa'i mdzes sdug sku//bkrasku'i/tshangasadabyangasadabyangasasnyanadrugasa'i5548 gagaced ba'i pa/bkra shis kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nyikarmā gta'i zugs//bkra shis rnam rgyal rgyal mchog ston padamu rgyal sras pos dge legs stsol//dmar ser mdangs ldan mtshan dpe'i ye shes mtshar sdug sku//dbyangs snyan drug cu'i 'gyur khugs 'gag meda'athagasungan/shes bya kun la pa ra mi tā'i mkhyen gter thugs// smra ba'i seng chen phongs r+sā 'khor phor dgyes dgur rol// rmad byung mkhyen gzigs dbyings su dpal rgyu zhing // skal bzang yid 'khor shar ba'i zla shel dbangan/kun mkhyen gter 'dzin sgra dbyangs rgyal mo yis//bdag blo'i ku mud rings su rtag skyongs shig/rje gcig mkhyen gnyis bslab gsum dpyis su phyin//thugs rje bzhi ldan ye lnga'i rgyud drug groX//

'phags nor bdun ldan mtha' brgyad rnam grol zhing //theg dgu kun mkhyen pra(wer zhis skyongs//skye med klong yangs bon sku'i gshis su rol//'gag med rdzogs sa'e gar bsgyur smra ba'i sengan/gdul bya kun 'dren sprul sku'i 'phrin las can//nam mkha' blo gros byang chub bar du bsnyen//khregs chothod lta bas ka dag lam byed cing //thod rgal bsgoms pas lhun grub klong du grol//gsal stong rjen par rtogs pa'i mkhyen lnga ba//rtsabargyud bla ma bde chen 'khor le'i rgyan//skyabs gnas yul mchog tsa tur gcig bsdus shing //skyabs masnu ga da11na gsas bla ma'i tshul bstan pa//skyabs gsum kun 'dus snang zhig kun mkhyen rnams//skyabs su mchi'o cing dbus pad mtshor bzhugs//rtsis rig lam gsum 'gro yi 'jings zab sogs//gsal byed stine pa 'dren mgro ga dmu rgyal sras//shes can bcu gnyis zhang bode mkhas rnams la//gus pas phyag 'tshal lag pad snying gar thum//2

mtha' yas shes bya'i chu ma1—ngas yangs pa las /mkhyen brtse'i gzi byin rtsedaga' rab 'bar bas//ma rib/ dra ba'i 'chang rgya las grol rje//〈snas shes rtsis mkhan zhang lnga da mkhas rgyu'i ltasteg/lung rigs rnam dag ke la sha ri'i sgor//lnga rig rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i 'gying stabs kyis//phas rgol glang bo'i klad 'goms smra ba'i seng //kun gzigs bshes gnyen rnams la mabeshas phyag 'tshal//bcu rig zla ba'i ma ma'i 'jings zab la//tshegs med rgyu ba'i rig 'gros gru gcings 'di//legs bshad 'phrul 'khor tshangs pa'i bskrun 'dra ba//ngo mtshar gzigs mor spyon nas dgyes dgur rol//sgro skur phyogs lhung ling tog mthar byed nas//gzur gnas mkhas dbang mig ldan 'ga' mchis tshe//rtsis rig rnam bshad shes bya kun gsal la//legs nyes cha yi spang blang dbye bar 'tshal//ngo mtshar d+dha ti'i mthongs chen rtsis rig la//'du shes gsuyopa'i spyod yul min na yang //3

skal mnyam dag la phan pa'i gsos sman tsam// spel ba yin phyir 'gal ba'i cha ci yod// rab snyan legs bshad ༷ra gyi sgra bshu'i dbyangs/ /rab gsal skal ldan mdangs mtha' yad rgu la//rab tu phan pa'i sgro tshogs legs bkram nas//rab dga'i zlos gar bsgyur ba rang gshis yin//lnga rig gzhung la sbyangs pa'i 'bras rtags kyis//lnga rig gur ṇi dpyid kyi dpal du 'khrungs// lnga rig phyogs 'ayi 'byung rtsis rings su bstar//lnga rig smra ba rnams kyis dga' ston mdzod//༈ shes rab lha mchog skulnga las/ smra ba'i seng chen ser boyis// 'ag rten snying rjes dbyings gziṭa nas// srid pa'i rus tsho ji bzhin sprul// desang gan rkyal tshuladu gnas// mgo bo nar bstan der phyogs me// mjug ma byang la 'byung ba chu// gzhogs g.yas shar la khams ni shingan/ gzhogs g.yon nub sto'abyung ba lcags// yanag thomasabazhirabarkyang phyor+sā/ tshangs yichagaga'igazhiyinabar+sā//rugasagatsosnodamasarna// 'aca'aphasos rimargan si//'byung i rusab /da༄na tseskya'achubacanasnolhorang nagol/ sa mar+sāganya༄ ru a// arnyo rten 'brelagangagasogags//losto rnam4༄gakhor//rnamashesabargyad sposakhabargyad//༅dgu'atshosmisogaya lisarabargyadasngagatso'adzod tho// snatshogasnya shu rtsabargyad las// rgyu skar nyi shumibargyad srid//de ni ji ltar srid zer na//dperasga shar phyogs mchin rtsalas//'byung ba shing srid de ra ni//44 rabu

stag yos zin dang phur bu dang / snar ma dīn druganabs sodangan/ mgo lag rgyal sogs shar skar drug/ de dag rnam sa kyi 'byung ba shing // lto phyogs snying gi mkhams las// 'byung ba me srid der rta sbrul// li dang nyi ma mig dmar dang // nag pa sa ri dbo me bzhi// mchu dang gre sogs lto skar drug/ de dag kun gyi 'byung ba me// nub chu gas blo ba'i mkhams las// 'byung ba lcags srid der bya sprel// dwa dang pa sangs gnas pa dang / chu khyod chu smad ston dang snrubs// lha mtshams gro bzhin nub skar drug/ de dag kun gyi 'byung ba lcags// byang cadags mkhal ma'i cangakhams las// 'byung ba chu srid der byi phag/ spar kha khams dang zla lhag gnas// nam gru dbyu gu khru /sa ྅rngod smad// snangan gre 31na gru byang skar drug/ de rnams kyi 2sna 'byung ba chu/ /mtshams bzhir mtsher ba'i mkhams las// 'byung ba sa ru srid pa ste// shar the 'brus zon skag dang gsum// lto nub lug khon sa ga bsum// nub byang khyi khen byi bzhan gsum// byang shar glang thin bra nye gsum// de 11gas kun gyi 'byung ba sa// spen pa sa khams mtshams bzhir gnas //rā hu spyi khyab 'byung lnga tshang // 7 shing ni skye ba me sreg pa// sa ni brtan pa lcags sra ba// brlan zhing gsher ba chu ru bshad// 7 shing ni nar mo me zur gsum// sa ni gru bzhi lcags zla gam// chu ni zlum po'i dbyibs su bzhed// 7 shing ljang me dmar sa ni ser// lcags dkar chu mthing kha dog lnga //7 ma thob chen shing la mdzub snu me// gung sna sa la srin lag lcags// mthe'u chung chu ru shes par bya//7 bcig shing gnyis me gsum ni sa// bzhi lcaṭa lnga chu 'byung grangs bshad// 7 rtsis gzhi 'byung ba chen po lnga // shing me sa lcags chu lnga yin// gang brtsiji snyed skor 'go kun// mibyed ma budagra groṭa bzhed// g.yas su bsgor bas ma ru byung // ma yi ma de dgra ru 'dod// g.yon du bskor bas bu ru byungan/bu yi bu de groṭa kyang 'dod// yang nayar 'ded ma mar bu// a phyi dgra la tsha bu grogs// de dag brtsotshul kun gyi gzhi// shing ma chu la chu ma lca gas// lcags ma sa la sa ma me// meyi ma ni shing zhes bsnyad// shing bu me la me bu sa// sa bu lcags la lcags bu chu// chu yi bu ni shing zhes brjod// shing dgra lcags la lcags dgra me// me dgra chu la chu dgra sa// sa yi dgra ni shing zhes grags// shing 11gas sa la sa bo gas chu// chu cadags me la me 10gas lcags// lcaṭa kyi 11gas ni shing zhes gsungs// zhes rtsis rig (5

shes bya kun gsal sa ྅ na 'gro'i skabs kyi rab tu byed pa ste dang ngos // ༈ de nas mkhas pa'i zhal rgyun ltar// brtsobar bya ba 'di lta ste// khamasadanga'abyugarnamabashadadangan/ 'og men sparakha sgyudaragad//zla zhag dus dang gza' skar dngan/ dgu mig dguduradur mig sku gas// go rim bzhin du bstan par bya//dang bo rus khams keg jidang / kung shang 'u dang lnga ru bshad// skad 'gag gre 'dar keg shing khams//sga rigs yin phyir lug la bla// so bar sgra 'don ji me khams // sgorigasayinate ra la bla// lte khung dbugs sdud kung sa khams// garo/nga rigs yin phyir shwa bar bla// kha gdang lce 'byar sna nas dbugs//shugs chen phyung ba shang lcags khams// dbra rigs yin phyir rkyang la bla// mchu sdud mchu 'dzum 'u chu ste// 'gyu rigs yin phyir g.yag la bla// de sogs nus chen sde lngar bzhed// 7 lo 'go shing pho byi ba yin// rab byung 'go ni me sku sa te// zla 'thod dpyid ra sngag nas brtsams// zhag gi 'tho dayang stag yin bsnyad// dus chodad thog mar nam langs yos// zhes sogs bshad tshul mang ba'i dogs// 'on kyang tshes la sku na tan gcig/ gza' la sku na tan bzhi 'gyur bzhed// sgar ma sku na tan brgyad 'gyur grasas// dus sbyor mo na tan bye ba 'gyur// lha gnyis pa lo yi rnam dbye ni// dpe ra na byi ba glang stag sku sa// 'brug sprul rta lug sprel bya dang // khyi phag la sku/gas nyi ma'i grangs// de rnams khyodags mtshams gnas luṭa ni// shar rjodad stag la shar smad mo sa// shar lto mtshams su g.yu 'brug gnas//rdzo stod sprul la wo smad rta// lto nub mtshams su lug gnas la// nub stod sprel la nub smad bya// nub byang mtshams su khyi yis dbang // byang stod phag la byang smad byi// byang yar glang sobs rim bzhin gnas// de yang pho tsho 'i rnam dbye ri byi stas 'brug rnga sprel khyi pho// glang yos sgrul lug bya phag mo//stag sprul sprel phag ra ba bzhi// yos rta bya byi 'bring bo bzhi// 'brug lug khyi glang tha chung ngo // re sogs 'byung ba lngas dbye na// lo 'gros drug cu tham pa sri da// kun la sro ga lus dbang zu nga bzhi// 7dang bo srog khams ngos 'dzin ni// stag mo sa sro ga shing sprul rta me// sprel bya lcags la phag byi chu//glang 'brug lug khyi gshed bzhi sa// 7 lus khams sde mig bstan pa ni// shing gi byi glang rta lug 6

nib mal ge'adrug rta / te/ sno r+shasna / lgepon/ / (cha da nas shege kha// — 7༄/ṭ+wāṃ dzilos/ / / sde 'e 7 ba' ni rigata / ri r+sha/ (6he ru )〈sna 'i 'a cha / tsā rje ) slong ( 634 95ci—3 〈sna ༄ mo deri po༄ ༄ ༄ /tsho no/ zhe/ ji 6

bzhi// chu yi stag sku1sa sprel bya bzhi// lcags kyi khyi phag 'byug sprul bzhi// 'byung khams nang 'phrad byung bas tshe// bcu gnyis po 'di'i lus khams lcags// de ltar so so'i khams de yis// rang rang dbang thang gang yin la// zhib dpyad ma casar brtags byas nas// 'thab pas ma dang 'phrad na shing // bu 'phrad chu la dgra 'phrad sa// cadags 'phrad lus khams me ru bzhed// 7 dbang thang brtselugs 'di lha ste// lo 'phros rnam pa bcu gnyis po// re rer 'byung ba lnga lnga yis// shing byi nas bzung chu phag bar// lo rgan drug cu'i gral rim ni// shing me sri lcags chu lnga yis// pho mo gnyis gnyis sbrag 'ded bya// tsonam lo shar ba'i lo rtags 'o/// gcig bcu ra nga la gnyis gsum ma// bzhi lnga dgra la drug bdun grosas// brgyad dgu bu ru shes par bya// gnam lo mo shar gcig gnyis rang // gsum bzhi ma la lnga drug dgra// bdun brgyad grogs la dgu bcu bu// de sogs rang rang 'byung ba yin// de yang pho lo mo lo zhes// byi stag 'brug rta sprel khyi pho// glang yos sprul lug bya phag mo// shing byi nas bzung chu phatra/ bar// pho mo gnyis re 'byung ba re// sbyar bas lo rgan drug cu bsnyad// 7 klung rta ngos 'dzin bstan pa ra bya// rtsaba'i lo 'gros bcu gnyis la// gsum tshan bzhi ru phye ba las// ra ba 'bring bo tha chung sasum // ra ba bzhi nas cingabar 'thodad// klung rta mthun par bsdebs pas na// mthun gsum zhes su bshad pa yin// 'byung ba sa yi klung rta me// bzhi tshan gsum du phye ba las// stag dang sprel dang phag dang sprul// ra ba bzhi zhes de la bya// ga/nyis nag lnga ser brgyad dkar gsum// ra ba bzhi yi/ skyes ṭ+wā/0yica snye// bya dang khyi ba yos bu rta// 'bring bo bzhi0zhes de la bya// gcig dkar bzhi ljang bdun da6/ra spru/susnu/ (/ 'bring rga bzhiyi skyes sme yin// glang dang lug dang khyi dang 'brug/ tha chung bzhi zhes de la bya// gsum sgyukhon drugasadakar dgu dmar gsum// tha chung ba'i/ yi skyes sme yin// klung khru mthun gsum bams0gcig ste / phyi 'byug spre'/ gsum klung ltag shing // phag sku sa lug gsum klung sgrul me / stag rta khyi gsum klung sprel lcags// bya glang sgrul gsum klung phag chu// gshed bzhir sa yis bsab mi 'ang76da// 7 bla khams kha cig lus mar bshad// 11ga mar 'alhasad pa lung ngang mthun//7

za rab klung klung rta'i bu ru bzhed// 'o/ 'acadas drug cu rang rang gi/ srog mgo lus zhwa dbang thang gos//klung rta ska rags sme ba gdan// gnam lo'i sredag lusadabang klung bzhi// 'byung ba bzhisku/da bzhi ldan lo//gsum lagasum ldanaganyisaganyis ldan// de ltar ma nor brtag par bya// 7 kha4na lolnga bstan pani//1 ga khamasadabang khams gcig pa la// khapagan 'o dgos bya baspegan// dbang khams sku ga gi bur spo nga tshe//se zhig loyin dbang khams ni// srog gi mar song khong nong lo// srog gi grogs song kha ral lo//srog gi dgrar song mdun khur lo// lo dang rus khams mthun sdeb ni// 7 shing thams skag la 'di ltar babe/ stag yos byung na dbang loyin// byi phag byung na ma lo yin// rta sgrul byung na bu loyin//khyi 'brug gnyis ni grogs lo yin// bya sprel gnyis ni dgra lor 'dod// lug ni chad chen glang chad chung //7 me khams ji la chad chen khyi// chad chung 'byug la t+ta sbrul dbangan/ stagastonas ma la glang lug bu//bya sprel cadags la byi phag dgra// 7 sa khams kung la chad chen 'brug/ chad chung lug la bya sprel dbang //khyi 'brug ma lu byi phag bu// stag sku/sa 11gas la rta sgruladagra// 7 chu khams 'u la chad chen 'brug/chad chung khyi la byi phag dbang // bya sprel ma la stagaspenas bu// rta sgrul bo/gas la glang lug dgra// de dag ma budagra grogs babe/ ma la ma lo bu bu lo// dgra la dgra lo grogs grogs lo // lo dang khams gcig dbang loyin// shing dur lug la me dur khyi// sa khyi 'brug la lcags dur grubaka/ ra ba bzhi nas dbug blangs na// tha chung bzhi la dur du zhugs// dur zhugs gang yin chad chenayin// de yi bdun zur da chungayin// rang loganam lo ra ba'i tshe// gcig pa rang gegaganyisatadadagra// gsum pa bye bral bzhi bzhi gshed// lnga ba lnga mthun drug drug 'grogs// bdun pa bdun zur rnams kyi sheg/khyi nas glang bar lcags bzhi dang // stag nas bya bar me brgyad la// lcags kyi bya khyi sa glang 'brug/me sprel chu sprul skar chung drug/ lha gsum pa log men brtsotshul ni// skyes pa rang rang dbang thang gi/bu yi stag nas zuradu sgrubs// rang rang lo grangs gangayin bgrangan/ deyis log men 'khrul med rnyed//bud medadabang thang ma yi sprel// gyen du lo grangs bar bkren pas// gang babs lo de log menayin//8

mtshon ngan// snang brgyad tshe chog sdong rgyan bya// 7 kho na kham bsdeb na god kha 'byung // bdud btsan zhal bsgyur sel khrus dang // gzungs bsdus spyi maro/sa rim cad bya// 7 gin phra na bu brgya rabs chad de// gnam khyi'i maro/sa dang gzungs bsdus bya// za 'i khon bsdeb na bye bral nyen// gdugs dkar sher snying geg bzlog bya// za da zon tshe chog sprang ston dang // sa bdag gter mdos rim cad zhes grags// grwa lnga tshe mdo tshe bsgrub bya// za da kham byer zhig 'byung nye bas// dbo na brtsegs bye bral chod ga lha gas//7 khon zin bsdeb na dge mtshan byung // dgra sri mnan kyang dgra bsdudag bya// za 'i kho na bsdeb na bu lnga skye// 7 khon dwa bsdeb na brgyad dgu 'byung // dwa shin bseb na gsum mam lnga // shin kham gnyis sam gsum skye zer// gin zin bu gcig bu mo gcig/ phra na gnyis// de sku gas skyes rlung spar kha bsdeb// 4 bcu gnyis sme ba'i bab klung ni// phan tshun sku ga lus dbang thang dang // klung rte sme ba gcig pa rnams// nang bsdeb byung na za thang chung // gnyis nag nang 'phrad byur 'dus yin//sme ba ma bu 'phrad na legs// dgra 'phrad shin tu ngan zhes grags// mo ni gsum mthing sgyu bdun dam ra// sme bdud yin zhes nang sdeb ngan// bsdeb na spe ba'i gto bcos bya// lha bcu gsum dar gud bstan rim ni// bu mo'i lus dang dbang thang nas// dbugs len bu yi 'o/ steng phab// lnga ga 28

dbyar ra'i tshes bdun dang // yos lo dbyar 'bring tshes dgu dang // 'brug lo dbyar tha'i nyi shu drug /sprul lo ston tha'i tshes bdun dang // sprel lo dgun ra'i bcu drug dang // bya lo dgun 'bring bcu dgu dang // khyi pho dgun tha'i nyi shu bzhi// phag lo dpyid ra'i tshes brgyad la// sbyor byas bag ma'i las 11gas bkag/ 7 gnam khyi dus su ba11da pa'i skabs// dpyid tha lhag gi nyi ma la// 1— rangs dus su zas 'tshothol yin// dpyid 'bring sprel sgrul nam phyed dus// dpyid ra 'brug gi the rangs dus// dbyar tha bya sprel rta'i nyi dros// dbyar 'bring lug 'brug phag nyi shar// dbyar ra lug sprel yothos nam langs// 〈snan tha byi sku sa sprel nyin phyed// 〈snan 'bring 'brug lug phag 11da chen//ston ra sgrul rta lug nyi dros// dgun tha stag yogabyi phag srod// dgun 'bring glang sprul stag nyi nub//dgun ra glang stag 'brug phyed 5thol// rgyu skabs bag ma phyir 'don ngan// gal te dbang med 'gro dgostos3// lug sha rkang ba'i bus snu sogs// sku da pa gcig gis brgyan padang // gang rgyu'i 〈(gas des sgrib som nyi dben// za bcu gsugarten 'brel legasabyas rtsis// bza' zla mo yi srog lus sogs// legs brtag skra bams khrus gsol dngan/ rgyan chagabargyan pa'i shed bu yi// dbang bskyed phun tshogagaming bkra legs// rigs bzang srog bskyedadabang klung dar// gos bsgon skyel gabakra shis brjod// 'bras dang rgyun 'brugazho la soṭa// bu ram shingatog bkra shis zas// dgos dgur smin nas shis brjod bya// zla mo mthun gsum pho ba dngan/ 'og rta lus kyi khadog bsnun//lus bskyed ma yis rta khrid bya// 7 sna bcag bdun zur bzhigashed bya// 7 5bonadagagatsang rigs btsun pa// bskyed rdzogaganyinga'adzin rab ldan pas// snangagashen la sogs thegadagu ltar// bkrashis rten 'brel mtshams sbyor bya// gos bsgonaskrusagasol rta khridadangan/ pho dzosna thon mi bzhid// 7 5len chung ma'i babs spar brtag/ li la rtadang khon la lug/ dwa la ra dang khen la khyi// kham la phag dang shin la glang // zin la bong bu can la rtol// khyo rka'i gos bsgon ska rags bcings// deyi bag ma'i sna len brtson// 7 bag mar bzhag par 'di ltar bsnyad// sgo rgyab thab maka rtsadangan/ bla gab med pa sogs la ngan// 'og gdan med na sa bdag gnod// sna bon med na sde brgyad 'du// dge mtshan bkra shis byin can gyi// khangabazangabazhi'aphanadaradangan/ phun sum tshogs pas rgyan gyis brgyan//grum tse phying dkar sogs bting nas// de'i steng 'byu dkar 'bras sogs kyis// bag ma'i srog khams ngan par// rdo je rgya gram 'bri bar bya// lus khams ngan na 'khor pho 'bri// dbang ngan g.yung drung bzhi bstol 'bri// rlung ngan pad ma 'dab brgyad 'bri// de'i steng bag ma legs bshod nas// mda' rgod dar mtshon sna lnga dang // me long sogs kyis legs brgyan zhing / de nyid lag pa g.yas kyis gzung // ca ༄ga rten 'brel gang legs dag/ g.yang 'gugs shis brjod rabatu bya//lha saba'i sa bcad gsum pa ni// bathothos thabs rim 1—gang datho sa pa'i// bag ma'i gtsor byas khyim tshang sar// bkra shisadage legs phun tshogs phyir// gser 'ode'abum rgyas bsdusa'abring gsum//rgyal mtshan tshes rlung rta'i rigs // bskal bsdongasanas gnod//de rnams gtor bcos rig pas dpyad// log men rang lo'i steng phyin na// rang lus rangagis mithes na// khyad par dgra jog phyin na ngan// yun ringata 'amasang na 'chi// ma dang grogs thog bzang ste 'tsho// bu thog phyin na btang sgomasayin// de kun 'o sbog 'thab pas shes// lha gnyis pa spar kha'i le lan ni// za 'i jog na skabs btsan thel gnod// lus stod na zhing tsha nad che// gcad byed byang ngam lho phyogs nas// sgo sgor bstan zhing khyi rta dmar// yod sar bza' mi bzhi tsama'ad//mo mang mdog dmar ku re dga'// shes gsal zer ba'i ming can yin// 'khrug bcos gdugasadakar gnam thel bkar// gzungs bsdus btsan 'dos rim gro bya// lha khon jog na na btsog phog lan//sa bdag yogadone gnodapayin// rdzogub mtshams sgogu gsum zhingan/ khyi ser bza' miganyis bzhini//gang rungayod cing spyod pa rtsub//rin ming phyogasanas gshod byed 'ongan/zor mdos ma yobatsan mdosadang //'dre bkar bzlog bsgyur yang dag bya// za da thog na skabs btsan gdon gcade// rtsibs phyogs lus phyed snying sogs shing sgo can// khyi skya rta ldan bza' miyangan/ kha 'chamasan lag 'theng 'gro / byed// nam lha'i ming ldan zhig gis gnod// sa bdag 'khrug bcos rgyal maro/sa bya// 7 kham cadags na skabs mtsho sman gnod// lus smad mkhal nad na zhes bshad// nad zas zos phyir sgom gyis lan//sgo byang sgo phyogs gang rung bstan// nor mang khyi nag bza' mi lnga // nag sngo chu rten ming can gshod //klu 'bum bdud mdos khrus sogs bya// 7 gin thog na skabs skyangs 'bur 'byungan/ rkang g.yas na zhing thab gcasnab lan// gnyan gdoston lha 11gas ma dga' grags// bse rags rgyal 'bo nga gri shi gca da//byang shar gnode// dpyi g.yas cadags suyang yang na// sa gnyan shing bcad lcags blangs lan//shar sgo bstan zhing khyi dkar sngo // gang rung yod cing rta bong bdog/ bza' mi kha yar sha mdog dkar// sgrani sil bur mi sngon po// klu dang rgyal bo las gras gcade// spang kong gzungs bsdus 'gong bkar bya// za zon jog na skabs yul 'dre gnod// lag g.yas spyo 'thogo lus stod na//za 'dre dar zab blangs pas lan// sgo ni sgo shar phyogs su bstan// khyi rgya mdzod rtol rmyo mang bdog/ skyon ma 'phyon ma'i ming laganod// rgyal mdos bzlog bsgyur mdo sde bya// lha gsum pa sme ba'i be+e lan ni// gcig dkar 1—gtu na skabs su// yul gnas sa bdag klu gnyan gnyostod//rlung nad mgo 'khor cing gzer 'ong // dgrabakhyog spangakodastonacagayobya// za gnyis nag thogatu na gyur na// bdud sri gnod sbyin klu sogs gnod// lus stod glang thabs sogs na zhing // bsgog bsgyur bdud mdos brgya mchod bya// za gsum mthing steng du na skabs su// sa srin klu gnyan skusnags kyis gcade// sgyu mchin chu 'gags dmu chu na// zhing dur sa la gdon rigs gnas//kha smras tshong nyes 'ong zhes bsnyad// spang kong klu chog klu gtor bya// za bzhi ljang thog tu na gyur na//46

shar nub phyogs nas klu gnyan gnod// shing bcad lan phyir kha yogs 'ong // zha grum mdze dang yan lag na// shing dang chu mig la gnas gdon// shing bcad lan zhing bslu ba 'byung // klu 'bum klu brgyad mdos chog bya// 7 lnga ser steng du na skabs su// dngos rdzas 'od can byung bas gnod//pho nad 'on skugs rmi lam mang // dgra bla rgyal 'gong gdon zhes bsnyad// mchod rten mkhar las bshig nyen gyis// snang brgyad sa bdag 'khrug bcos bya// 7 drug dkar thog tu na gyur na// bud med sgab 'dre'i rigs sku gas gcadad// kha so rims nad na bar grags// dar+sha ra bdag rigs kyi 'gal rkyen gdon// bskang bshags khrus dang 'gong bkar bya// za bdun dmar thogatu na skabs su// gre bo gdon rigs sogasani gnod// gnyan skrangs khrag gzer tsha nad 'ong // sna khrag dmar thab sogs ni lan// khyod la btsan gyi gzer mda' 'ong // yam shud mdos dang btsan bsdum bya//za brgyad dkar thog tu na gyur na// lha khros spyo 'bog grib kyang na// nyen ni lha la mi gtsang phog//cadi la phritang gzer thabs ldangan/ gtsang khrus 'bo ba'i lha lnga gasku // g.yang 'gugs tshe bsgrub bkra shis bya//7 dgu dmar thog tu na gyur na// bdud dang gcad sbyin la sogs gnod// rims yams dag gi nad ngo che// yugs sa'i zas zos sogs kyis nyen// gtsugator gdugs dkar spyi mdos dang //bskang gaskudal g.yang 'gugs ba11ga bsgyur bya// za bzhi ba nyi ma'i le lan ni// byi nyin na skabs 'bar 'bur skrangs// nyon mchod lha rigs ma dgyes pas// mo rigs nad lci zhes kyang zer// 7 glang nyin pho mchin snying sku gas na// bse rags gre tho gtu mo gcadad// lhu tshigs mi bde snu nad snyi// za ga nyin mkhal rnyed mdun rgyab gzer// klu gnyan btsan rigs dag gis gnode// pho rigs skusnags la nad lci zer// klu bsang bskang bshags lha ga11la bya// 7 sku sa nyin rnyed pa malha so gas na// klu srin rgyal the'u phung sri gnod// pho las mo lci na bar bshad// za 'brug nyin nang khrol gro snying na// mnol dang thab gzhob gyis lha khros// mo las pho lci na yang zer// sprul nyin brang dang tsha nad na// sa gnyan shing gnas rmasogasagacad// mo rtsisan ring wa'ing bsnyad// rta nyin zug zer brgyaland 'ongan/ gre mo khyim lha gnod ces bshad// mo las r+shahrī nayang zer// 7 lug nyin na skabs gso dka' bzhed//ca 47

gre btsan bse rags rigs su gnod// gri mtshun gasku la zhing bsdu ga bsgyur bya// 7 khrol nyin yi 'chus snying 'dar bsnyad// dngos rdzas mi gtsang sa bdag gnod// mo lci sa bcos pho yang zer//7 bya nyin yan lag rus pa na// mi gtsang rdzas kyis lha rigs gnod// klu chog lha gsol thab bsang bya// za 'i nyin ngal dub g.yo 'gul dka'// dkor bdag gnam the'u rigs dag gnod//bzlog bsgyur gdugs dkar 'gong bkar bya// 7 phag nyinadabugasatad skyug bro 'byungan/ rigs rgyud snga ma'i shi 'dres gnod// gzungs bsdus gshed 'dul dur mtshun gsol// mo ni na lci pho yang bzhed// lha lnga ba gza' yi le lan ni// nyi mar lha 'khrug 'gal rkyen che// zla bar klu gnyan gnod par dogs// mig dmar ma bdud btsan rgyal 'khu// lhag par mas sman klu rigs gnod// phur bu ban cadan lha srung 'khrug/ pa sangs rgyal gnyen sku gas kyis nyen// spen pa klu gnyan sa bdag gnod// rim gro skabs ltar byed par bya// lha drug pa skar ma'i le lan ni// smin drug yugs sa rigs kyis lan// snar ma mi gtsang gzhobo kyis lan// mabo la kha smras zas rigs lan//lag ni 'a〈snan byed rkyen gyis lan// nabs so spengs dregs las kyis lan// rgyal ni lhurtog byed gnyan gyis lan// skag ni cadad 'khrug phra mas lan// mchu ni 'dod bshad rigs kyis lan// gre ni shing gnyan bcad pas lan// dbo ni 〉ste 11ga sa bar+shasna lan// me bzhi 'jigs skrag las kyis lan//nag pa ma chosang zas kyi lan// sa ri chag 'jig baXdzis pas lan// sa ga bcand 'grul skusnags kyis lan/ /lha mtshams gathosnen 'dre zhugs phyir lan// sbrusan ni 'khrab rigs ba11da 'grul lan// snubs ni zas rigs rkyen gyis lan// chud cu da mi gtsang brus pas lan// chu smad 'i/nga las rkyen gyis lan// nisto bzhin spyang rigs 'a11na gyis lan// byi bzhin rigs ngan 'brel bas lan// snangan gre khyim mtshes 'brel bas lan// snunan gru mi 'khyam rkyen gyis lan// khrums 〉de mi gtsang nas 11gas lan// khrums smad chang rigs skyur gyis lan// nam gru mo rigs 'grul gyis lan// dbyu gu chu malo1na rkyen gyis la na//bra nye klu btsan rigs kyis lan// de 11gas brta gas nas rim 11 bya// zhes rtsis rig shes bya kun sa/sa sulas nad rtsis thang shing ring mo bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga ba'o// //48

ra༅༅// rje gcig smra ba'i seng chen la// cad gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal te// srid 'dir legs nyes bya ba las// rkun rtsis rnam bshadatabya thā// 7 nyin re rten 'brel bcu gnyis po// re re 'khor ba'i 'bras bshad bstar// za ma rig pa nyin nor stor na// rkun ma byang gi phyogs nas yong //mi nag maro/ga ngan khyim nang du// yugs sa gcig gnas zhag dgu las// rtsad chodad na ni rgyu mi stongs// za 'du byed la ni rgyu stor na// rkun ma'i gos mdog ser skya'i rigs// gyon nas shar gyi phyogs su khyer// rgyun ring don nor rang lag 'khor// 7 rnam shes la ni rgyu stor na// rkun ma nang mi nyid tshe yin// stor na// rang grogs mdog ngan gcig gis khyer// rtsub kyang bston nas mi khug go// 7 phred nyin stor na rang rang gi// khyim mtshes mi nag cig gis khyer// de la btsugs na bston du 'ong // nor gzhan bskyal kyang khug par 'gyur// 7 reg par nor ston rkun ma ni// thag ring yul nas slebs pa yin// khyi nag yodad pa cig gis khyer// da skabs rnyed par dka' bar brjod// 7 tshor bar nor stor chung ngan 'gyur zhes grags// 7 rga shir nor 〈snar rkun ma ni// lus la mdze nad ske ring ba// sku chag tho sa skyas byang du khyer// zhag grangs nyer bzhir rnyed par 'gyur// 7 skye bar cadar lhor rkun ma gsum// sku da kyang gcig ni nang mi yin//bag tsam bgyis phyir rnyed par 'gyur// za srid par nor cu ra rkun ma ni// che ba bzhin mdzes skra nag gis// shar phyogs khyer zhing rang khug brjod// lha res gza' nyi mar nor stor na// khug gud mi rnyed dar na rnyed// /ma ma gsum yod byang nas yong // gcig ni gos nag ske lngar can//gnyis kyi khyodanacas dmar cadar brgyan// mi tshang khyim gsar gcig gi nang // mig steng sme yod khyim sgo yang // 3tho bstan sgo khyi 1sto skya sku da// bza' mi mig gamosto ba cig dang // gcig nyo shar ram nub tu 49

blta// khyi nag rkang lag nag dkar yod// bza' nang mi gcig rna bsangan/ yag po mi gsang yugs sa mo'i// khyim gyi byang phyogags sbas nasaspend// 7 zla ba la ni nor cu ra na// mi khug rkun ma gsum po ni nor stor na// khug mi yong ba'i nyen che bshad// rkun ma mi dgu byang nas yongan/ bud med kha che sna nyag pa'i// bo sa dkar 〈ston zhing yan lag ni// skyo na can gcig gis khyer zhes bzhed//gcig nidapral ba'i skra dkar ba// gos gong sne la lhag ma yod// rkang ba khyi thug khyim sgo shar// bstan te khyi mdog ser skya bdog/ rku mkhan bya tshang shing 'og sbas// 7 phur bu la ni nor stor na//rkun ma gsum yod lto nub nas// yong ba'i rkang ba skyon can yin// maro ga nag so 31na mgo rma yod//sgo shar bstan zhing khyi rta ser// yod pa'i khe tshong byas pa gcig/ grong smad ban de'i khang ba'i da//sgo ni byang gi phyogs su bstan// khyi nag lag dkar yo da pa yi// bu gcig glen zhing sha mdo ga sngo //mig rna lag tshigs sbas pa yi// 〈( nub bstan te watas nag 11na// de'i brgyud sri khar shi ba por+shad//khyi skya yod pa'i lha khang ngam// yang na them bar ra bar sbas// pa spen pa la ni nor stor na// khug sku1nga byang shar nas byung zhingan/ lag /ma gcig gis khyer zhes bsnyad// gcig ni rkang g.yas zha 'theng ba//ske la lnga ba yod par grags// sgo ni nub bstan khyi khra yod// de yi bu brgyud gcadang can nam// beb can lam ring la shi ba/ yo da cing lus rgyud bzhin nyams legs// res gza' gud zhud mi rnyed zer//50

'gyod 'bring dar stor rnyed ces lho//ces rtsis rig shes bya kun gsal las rkun rtsis kyi rabatu byed pa ste drug pa'o//lha cis mkhan srung sngags 'di lta ste// gang byas las la shin tu gces// nus sbal gzugs ris shog gur bris// res gza'i sngags kyis tha mar bskor// dkyil du yi ge hriḥbris nas// lus la btags na phan par bzhed// nyi ma'i sngags ni 'di lta ste// yo4 de ye su hāḥ zla ba'i sngags kyang 'di ltar bzhed// oṃ sa ma ye swā hā migatamar gzungs sngags tabya thā// oṃ ra ye swā hāḥlhag pa'i sngags ni 'di lta ste// oṃ phu ra ye swā hāḥ phur bu'i gzungs sngags 'di ltar bsgo// oṃ bra na sa nyi ye swā hāḥ pa sangs gzungs sngags tabya thā// oṃ shu tra ye su hā spen pa'i sngags kyang 'di ltar bzhed// oṃ sha ne+e du tse ya te swā hāḥ1/ 77)rngo) rdzo rdzo sa dze ske〉 snyo sto 51

༄/ /rmad byung khyung sngon skyes kyis legs drangs shing //mkhyen brtse'i mngon rtogs khri gdugs snang ba ches//mun sel nges don 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen//srid mtha'i bar du snying dbus khab tu bzhugs//7mad byung legs bshad shes bya kun gsal las //skyes dgu'i d+ku ra phyi nang gsang ba'i keg/bzang ngan blang dor gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du//gsal bar 'char ba'i me long sman phyir spel//lha lo gcig keg rtsis zhe bdun ma'i// lag len mdor bsdus bshad par bya// mi 'gyur rtsaba'i del drug dang // gca dral nyer bzhi kha dmar bzhi// yibadun smos kho phrana'// dgalidur kho gakhong bal// 'dzomabadun go rim bstar// lha dang bo rtsaba'i rdel drug ni// gnam lo log men spar sme dang // dar gud dus phod drug la bsnyad// de nas gno dral rdel nyer bzhi//za gnam d+ku srog lus dbang klung bzhir// brtsibya'i srog lus dbang klung gis// so sor 'thab pa 'i ze'u bzhi// 7 de bzhin log men gang babs kyi// yar la gnam gyi 'ja thag srog/ mar la da nga ༄ ngas yi rten phur lus// yar brgyad gnam rgyang dbang thang dang // mar brgyad sa rgyang klung rta la//brdzici'i srog lus dbang klung bzhis// rim bzhin 'thab pa'i de'u bzhi// 7 de ltar babs spar gang yin gyi// khams la r+shabya'i srog lus dang // dbang thang klung rtas 'thab rdel bzhi// 7 babs spe lasang de bzhinadu// dkar gsum lcags la nag mthing chu// ngoser sa la bzhi ljang shingan/ dmar gasnya me yin yobya de'i// srog lusadabang thang klung rta yi// khams kyis so sor 'thab rdel bzhi//52

0bar brtag/ lus ni blon chen yin zhes grags//lus la na tsha yong min dpyad// dbang thang thu boyin pas na// za thang che chung zhib tu brtag/ klung rta 'khor g.yog yin pas phyir// grags snyam/ dge dang mi dge brtag/ yon tan can la rlung rta gtso//bud medadabang thang byis pa la// lus dang skyes par srog ni gtso// 7 de nas kha dmar del bzhi ni// sro ga rnams gcig bsgoms srog deladangan/ lus rnams gcig bsdoms lus del bzhed// dbang thang gcig pasgyu mas dbang shel dang // klung rta gcig bcadams klung shel bzhi// rde'u'i cad grangs mi 'grem/0pashā sku// ga nas sam do(ra 04go'i cad grangs 'a11ra// nag 11 du mas mang gyur na// delatag gnyisasu 'borabadangan/ gcib/ mang gcigatu bor ba'i phyir// dkar nag stom na phyed matag/legs nyes cha yang de yis thedzags// 11ga del dkar 11 gsum babs thongs// rang rang rlung khams dar stsog phul// nag gcig sāḥ chu gtor dang // mi phyugs glud ni dgra phyogs thongs//dkar nag gnyis babs spang kong dang // dgra sri mnan pa'i bya bar brtson// bzhi cha snyan zhing don la dben// bde ldan bshad kyang ngal tshogs yod// nad ni chu skran na nyen che// klu gnyan gcadad dang gzhan rigs la// phan byas tshur la dgra ru 'dzin// rigs mthun mang la kha 'thor byed// 7 kha yan lo ba gang yin kyang // rgyu nor 'phel 'grib gang mang 'byung // tshe mjug bde skyid 'ong bar bsnyad// mtho sar gzhan gyis 'jog dka' yang // dma' sar mi sdod bshad ces grags// mo bcingabya khong cathong 'o/ ba la// tshe stod sdug bsngal cho gas chen 'byung // khyod la rigs cibargyud gsum 'byung zhing // dar gud skyon gyi nor phyed stongs// gnod byed rkyen la rim gro bya// 7 kha ral lo ba gang de la// khyod kyi mes rigs thog mar dar// bar du'athor zhing yul gsum gyes// 'brug skad grags dang seng skad 'don// tsha zer nyi ma kun la shar// de lta'i rigs rgyud yin zhes legs// mo rigasayin na bu gnyis 'tsho// kha smras sdong zhing rgyal 'gong gnod// 7'dun khur 'o ba gang yin la// rgyun du dgra dang kha smras 'byung // mo la khyo shi bye bral 'ong // rgyu cadar gang bsags 'phel 'grib che// cadan kyang rig gsal sung ma yis// sgyustong 11gas mar+sha na skyabs byed ces grags// lha dus del dar gud 'bras bu ni// lus rdzogayoskyid pa'idusachen shar//btsas pa rgyu nor gang legaga'aphel// khrus byed lhagabasam ba/zhis༄0 rigrub// gos gon dge mtshan 'bring tsam shis// las byed rgyud rigs gzhi brling yin// dar ba longs spyod gter mdzodayin// de sku gas bzang drug 'bras༄ bzhed// dbugs len skalazad ces su grags// mngal gnas lus kyi gyur chenayin// gud pa nor la byed bral bsnyad// na ba skyon ldan phung 'gyod yin// shi ba g.yang rigs phongs pa yin// dur zhugs rgyun chad shor ba yin// de rnams ngan drug 'bras bshad sogs//medadu mi rung rdel 'grel grub// lha bzhi pa mi 'gyur klung shel lnga // shes byed spyi dang zur bkod brjod// pha ma rta sprul 'o/ ba yis// bu tsha gshed bzhi skyes pa na// dpangs mthosakhar brtsigs bzhin 65

du brjid// stag yos lo bas rta sprul btsas// mun selayode chen rabatu bzangan/ gshed bzhi rdzobs bya sprel btsas// mdung rtsisrin skang zhes kyang bya// bya sprel pho bas byi phag btsas// gnying med chu gter mtha'ayasabazhed// byi phag rdzobagastag yos btsas// rab mdzes rkang 'thung brtas pa ltar//7 pha mes byi 'brug sprelagasum la// shing klung gcig mthun skyes pa na// ka ba ma tshugs zhesate ngan// stag rta khyi la lcags klung btsas// shi chad lhag par gri nyes mngan/ 7 phag lugaskudas la me klung btsas// mtshang nad gri kha pha mes phye// 5 lcags bu chu skyes pha bas bu// rgyas shings bas tsha bo dar// 'byor ldan sum brgyud 'byung zhes bsnyad// 5 lcags ma sa skyes rlung phog ces// rgyu rdzas gang stongs phyugs god che// 5 lcags grogs shing btsas bu grir 'chi// shing la sa skyes za thang chungaka/me la lcags btsas pa dri 'byung // sa la chu skyes spyode ngan 'khrig/ chu la me skyes shicad bsnyad//yongs grags ma klung daradugadage/ rgyud tshe skyes na ngan rim bdog/ lhag par stag yos dwa btsas dang // sprel bya'i dang sgrul rta kham// phag byi khon dang gshed bzhi zin// spar gdan ngan zhes yongs sugrags// gshed bzhi li la skyes pa na// bud med mo ༷rngogs thams cad la// byams shing phag byi dwa btsagan// ma phyi'i gnas mkhar legs zhes bshad// sgrul rta zin la skyes pa na// mes po'i bskyangs lenarab tu smin// stagaspedas khon btsas klu gnyan gnod// stag yos khams btsas bsode nam6khas5gsaka/ byalhakha shin btsagabag mar nyen// sprul rta khen btsas mi mthun che// gshed bzhi zin btsas rgyu cathor 'pho// bya sprel mtshams bzhir skyes pa na// tshe dpal rtag tu 'gyur med brtanakhri7 ci'ikhen gin la skyes pa na / bu rgyud rigs ni gnyis bsam bzhi// dwa khor kham rnams gsum mam lnga // zin la skyes na lnga'am gcig/ zon la skyes na gcig gam bzhi// skyes tshe bu skyes slar yang bstud// khyim phyab skabs su sa btsas na// bu mo brgyad tsam skye bar dogs// 7 bag ma'i bgrang lo zhe gcig gam// bzhi bcur bu skyes srid tshod bsnyad// chu khyi chu phag btsas pa'i bu// srid gzhug ma chod phan jogs dben// za rang klung zla pa'idar gud ni// dpyid gsum stagalo1sa bya sprel skyes// dbyar 66

gsum rta sprul skyes riṭa dang // ston gsum gshed bzhi skyes pa'i riṭa// dgun gsum byi phag skyes pa sogs// sku so'i 11ga gi ma rnams las// dbugs len na niskur gsum gyi// zla bar skyes na pha mar ngan// de min kho rang 'chi nyen dogs// lha mi 'gyur klung rdel lnga bo yi// kha dmar dpal gyur ngos 'dzin 'brel// bu yi 1—ga klung gnyis po yis// pha yi 1—ga klung 'thab pas na// skyobo na pha yi dpal chen yin// gaskusnad na pha yi byur chen yin// bu yi lus dbang gnyis po yis// ma yi lus dbang la 'thab pa sa// skyob dpal gsod byur gong dang 'dra// dpal bzang byur ngan yongs la grags//7 lha dpal tshe 'dre bdud lnga yi// dbye ba rang skyes ma klung dang // de yi spar sme rang lo'i srog/lus dbang klung sogs mar gyur lha// bu gyur dpal dang nang 'phrad tshe// grogs 'phrad 'dre dngadagra 'phrad bdud// ma lus bu la 'thab pa yis// ma 'phrad byung na lha pho ba// bu 'phrad byung tshe dpal pho ba// 'byung nang 'phrad pa tshe pho ba// dgra 'phrad byung na bdud pho ba// grogs dang 'phrad na 'dre pho ba// lha pho yin tshe za thang che// bde ldan tshe ring longs spyod 'phel// dpal 'o pheṭar rgyas rigs rgyu da dar// tshe pho ba ni tshe ring zhingan/ 'gyur med tshe srog rabatu brtan// bdud lo tsheyang thung bar bsnyad// tshe 'gugs tshe sgrub rim gro dgos// 'dre lo bsode nams shinatu phongs// 7 gnyis pa lus kyi skyes klung ni// lha lo'i lus la na tsha dben// tshe pho la yang bde ldan 'byung // lus 'dre nad 'byung sdug bsngal spyod// lus bsgyur ming tho lo/ga gcad spangan/ lus bdud 'dre yis 'tshe bar byed// bdud maro sa lus kyis sgrib rjodang dbo sa// 7 gsum pa dbang thang skyes klung ni// gang pasam 'grub par 'gyur zhes bsnyad// dbang tshe 'o1ngas 1dedar zhing rgyas// dbangadapal casar ldan rigs rgyud 'phel// dbang 'dre g.yang gi ༷tho zhabs sna la// g.yang sgrub gser casad g.yang 'gugs bya//dbang bdud 'ostongs spyodengo/na du sgyu ngas// 7 bzhi pa klung rta'i skyes klungani// klung lha srung mas 17ngas khyodags byed// klung tshe bde skyid phun chosags rgyas/ / klung dpal las bya thams cad bzang // klung 'dre gnyen bsam dgra ru sdang // keg bzlog kha mchu bzlog par bya// klung bdud kha smras shinatu snang //67

dgra bzlog klung bskyed ka 'dzugs dang // klung rta dpung rgyan lam 'phrang bcos// bgrang lo nyer lnga man chad du// ma klung gtso zhing zhe lnga yan// pha klung gathe ste de gnyis bar// rang klung gtso shes mkhas pas gsungs// lha lnga ba brgya phrag shel 'bras ni// lha drug pa ltang gcadad nyi shus bshad //1 ga gi rang ral dkar ba na// chung dus gso sla rgas tshe ringan/ pha khu kun la bzang bar bcad// srog rdil nag byung chung gso dka'// tshe gzungs tshesgrub gang mang bya// 7 sgog gi ma shel dkar ba na//pha khu dar ba'idage mtshan 'byungan/ nag na pha khu dar gud che// 7 sog gi bu rdel dkar ba na// pha khyadar ba'i dge mtshan 'byungan/ nag na pha khu dar gud che// 7 slog gi dgra rdel dkar ba na// ljon gyind rigasadag la 'dzem// nag nadur sri cadagasadang bral// 7 lus kyi rang rdeladakar ba na//legs bya ci rigs 'phel ba dang // nag na dbang lha/na 'byung bar ro/gas// lus bskyed lus bsgyur srung bar bya// 7 lus kyi ma del dkar ba na// ma sru dang ni yun du 'aspyodags// nag na de cadag shes par bya// 7 lus kyi bu del dkar ba na// rigs rgyud lcam dral gasku sla zhing // nag na de sgyu ga sho gas par bya// 7 lus kyi grogs del dkar ba na// skyes pa bud med 'phrad pa dang //bud med skyes rigs 'phrad ces ba——da// 7 lus kyi dgra del dkar ba na// lus gcadad ngagra mang naganasang / gcong dben zhes kyang yongs su grags// 7 dbang thang rang rdel dkar ba na//rgyu nor phun tshogs dpal ldan zhingan/ nag na longs spyod myur du phongs// za dbang thang ma shel dkar ba na// bu zhang tsha bo yun du 'grogs// nag na de las ldog par bshad// 7 dbang thang bu shel dkar ba na// lhag par mo rigs mang du rnyed// nag na mo rigs skyon ldan 'phrad// za dbang thang blo gas shel dkar ba na// lo legs 'khor gasku ga kun gyis bceka/ cadar na de las cadag par byed//7 dbang thang dgra rdil dkar ba na// rgyu nor gzhan la shor ba dang // nag na rang rgyu rang gis spyod//7 klung rta'i rang sel dkar ba na// cadags byed lha srung rab tu 'kho ra// nag na rang phan gzhan gyis gca da// 7 klung rta'i ma rdil dkar ba na// bo nga ma'i rigs kyis skyabs bo gas byed// nag na 68

rigs kyis skyobs// nag na zla 1—gas kha rje'i nyams// 7 klung rta'i dgra rtel dkar ba na// phan byas ngan du gyur ba byed// nag na g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing // ltang gathongad nyi shu'i kha dmar grub// lha bdug pa dar gud bcu gnyis 7/ mardil nyer lnga'i 'bras bshad ni// srog gi rang shel dkar ba na// tshe 1—ga 'gyur med rab tu brtan// nag na tshe sgrub ci mang bya// 7 10ga gi ma rteladakar ba yis legs// nag na rigs rgyud ga11 dka' bzhed// 7 lus kyiX1gas rdol dkar ba na// chung ma'i bsod nams 'phel ba dang // nag na de las sdog pa'o// 7 lus kyi dgra rdil dkar ba na// pha mes las kyang rigs rgyud mtshar// nagata de cadag grogs skal chungan/ 7dbang thang rang rtel dkar ba na// btsan phyugs dpaladang ldan pa dngan/ nag na rgyu nor 'phel 'grib che// 7 dbang thang ma shel dkar ba na / shes ldan sring cesas phan 11gas byed// nag na de las casag pacad/ / 7dbang thang bu rtel dkar ba na// bu snu sa phan tshun byed padang // nag na de las dben pa so //7 dbang thang 11gas shel dkar ba na/ dpal 'acadar dge mtshan rgyas pa dang // nag na 'bru skal nyung bar ba༄de// 7 dbangaXthangadagra sheladakar bta// phyugs gode rgyu rigs 〈rnang 'jal cadangan/nag na de las ——ga pa yin// 7 klung rta'i skyes pha mara'aphrod// nag na de rigs phan thogs dben// 7 klung rta'i bu rtel dkar ba na//rigs rgyud shes yon can du 'phel// nag na de las sdog par 'dod// klung rta'i grogs del dkar ba na// tshong las dar zhing legs ldan shis// nag na rgyu nor 'a'od pa dka'akhri 7 klung rta'i dgra rdi la dkar ba na// mjo snang lasabya sdug bsngal che// nag na skrag snang shinatu dben// 7 khams kyi rang del dkar ba na// rigs bzang mdzes ldan 'du ba dang // nag na de sdogayin par gsal//7 khams kyi ma del dkar ba na// gong mas mgon dang skyabs byed kyang // nag na de las gol sa'o// 7 khams kyi bu rdel dkar ba na// longs spyod ldan zhing med du byung // nag na pha mas rigs rgyud stor// 7 khams kyi grogs shel dkar ba na// chung mar 'grogs ring legs ldan 'byung // nag na de las sdog par bzhed// 7 khams kyi dgra del dkar ba na// bsags pa'i rgyu rdzas gzhan la 'chor// nag na khyim gzhi bu yis 'dzin// 7 skabs 'dir snying bsdusatabya thā//srogagis tshe ring tshe thung brtag/ srog mas pha khu legs nyes bu che'i shesasngon bshe/klung grogs cig zlumadarabaXb bshe/klungadagras mikha 'byung min bshe/ zabargyad pa skyes tshang brgyad du bstar//dang bolo yi skyes tshang la// spyi dang bye brag gnyis po yi// rnamadabye gsal byed 'di nubagod//7dang tho lo gagar bcu gnyis ni//byi lor gang skyes sdangadagra mngan/ zhephugs brnag kyang mtshan 'gros rku// rang sems mi bde'i ༷༷ga pa chung //las bya rgya
