chung la la shin tu bce na// 7 glang 'othor gang skyes nyal dga' zhing // 'a1— 'gul lci ste gtsang sbra chung // za dga' las gang phyi dal che// ci yang mi byed byas pa na// sa gnam 'khrug ces smra bar byed// bcu drug bco brgyad nyer drug la// 'gal rkyen dbang du shor la dogs// 7 ga phor gang skyes dpa' rtsal che// spyod rtsub blo mang nga rgyal che// sho dga' gnyen brdzoshes spu bkra// 7 yos lor gang skyes g.yo sgyu che// pha ma zung la drin lan dben// thabs mkhas sto chung khong ngan yin//bad mkhris skuste na nga ca putre// 7 'brug 'o/ra gang skyes brnyas mi srid// brtson 'grus zhen kyang don mi 'asna ra//sems dkar 1— thung ku the che// na tsha tshabs chen byung bas skabs// nyen che gtam nyan rang chod chung /bde sdug sgoms shing drag rtsal che// sku lnga sku dgu zhe gsum dang // zhe dgu sogs la rtsub ces grags//7 5la lor gang skyes gdug rtsub che// gzhan gyis bcos med sems gting nag/ rang phung ma byed gzhan mi gnod// 7 rta 'o/ra gang skyes brtson 'grus che// gnyid chung rtsed dga' rta la byams//gzhan don shugs bskyed dar gud che// rdzu shugs ldan zhing tshe smad skyid// 7 lug 'o/ra gang skyes za dga' che// shes rā ngas spro ring smra ba nyung // so/ nam phyi bcadal gzhan phyogs spru// legs nyes cha yang sdudar thodangs la// phan gcadad chung la sku sa dal grags// tsa sprel 'o/ra gang skyes tshig mi brtan//snying chung rdzun smra las bya mngan/ rang snang mtho la bcos kyang sla// col chung batho ga zasayang yang za//7 bya 'o/ra gang skyes chags pa che// gnyid chung gtsang dga' rang tshod chung // kha tsha 'aX stangs mgo lus kyang // bcos 'gro gzhung bzung 'aspyodags bde zer// smo khyi phor gang skyes khro gtum che//blo sna mang la rkang masdudags ldan// 'bostodaga' gzhung bzang dar+shasnas don chung // chags che gang bsam ther 'don byed// ka ca dben phyir 'khyodad chung bsnyad// 7 phag phor gang skyes brtul zhugs che//rig rmongs gtsang btsog chung ba dang // grod pa che zhing za la dga'// rgas skyid rdzun mang khong gyong zer//7 bye brag 'osto bstar skyes tshang sku gas// drug cu'i legs 'bras shing byi ni// gamatho che klu nad cadang la nyen//longs khyodadapal 'bring rig pa gsal// bzo mkhas skye bo bsgyabar grags// tshe tshadadon lnga bar chang bdun//71

bu skal gsum mamayang na lnga // 7 shing glang lo ba gnyid che zhing //ri sa bdag gcadad cing sri kha ldang //ser sna che ste nor rdzas brtas// tshe tshad drug cu bar chad drug/ 7 me stag lo ba khengs dregs tshe//spro thung mig zum gcong nad 'byung // grogs la gnod kyang dad pa chung // shes ldan bad kon rlu nga mdze sogs// na ba'i nyen che bag ma gnyis// ldan zhing bu skal bzhi zhes brjod// tshe tshad don dgu bar chad lnga // 7 me yos lo ba snying rlung che// gzhan smad rang bstod sems gya gyur// g.yo ldan ngag rtsub mo la dga'// rgyu nor brtas shing tshe tshad ni// don lnga bar chad bdun du bsnyad// rgyal btsan sa bdag gcad pa yis // pha mes 1sto bya khyi zas skyone// za sa 'brug 'o1 ba g.yengab che// dpal 'byor shes yon rgyas pa dngan/ rdzun smra gzhan rigs bud med spyod// g.yo chece tshad don lnga la// bar cad drug dang bu skal lnga // yang na bdun bzhed nyes skyon che// za sa sprul lob nga rgyal che// zas nor che zhing sems zhinag/ g.yang nyams byes shi sa bdag gcad// tshe tshadadonadagu bar chad drug/ bu skal drug ldan gri mcho na dngan/ 'bras lha ga sku gas kyi shi lha gas mchis// pa lcags rta ho ba cadar god che// gnyen la dga' zhing gzhan skyon brtag/ zas sred le lo che ba dang // tshe tshad don bdun bar chad dgu// bu skal bzhi sku da gaskusteb dke'u// mkhar las byed phyir sa bdag gasnyad// grang rlung so gas kyi rkyen ngan byed// pa lcags lug 'o ba dran rig chung // kha smras mang zhing lus ni rgyas//tshe tshad gya bzhibar chad bzhi// bu skal dathozhe la 'gal rkyen mang // sa bdag klu btsan gcadad pa yin//7 chu sprel lo ba sgyur rtsal che// zas nor 'phel zhing dbang bo no// 'du byed bzang la mi nor skyob//tshe tshad nga bdun bar chad bdun// bu skal gsum ldan sa bdag gcade// 7 chu bya 'etho ba sems mi brtan// gasku che dgra snang gzhan dbang 'bo // g.yeng ldan ༷thogs mang brjed nges che// tshe tshad drug cu bar chad dgu// bu skal gnyis ldan klu sman gcade// 7 shing khyi 'odzi ba dran rig gsal// dme ngo che zhing rje bo 'ong // tshe tshad don dgu bar chad lnga // bu skal gsum ldan klu btsan 'khor// 7shing phag pho ba khro gtum che// mdza' bos bslu zhing bud med gnod// zas gnod lus sha che ba grags//72

tshe tshad re bzhi bar chad lnga // phugs ngan bar chad cadar gyis phan// 7 me byi 'osto ba nor srid che// rku byed smra mang gzhan mtshang 'byu// dran mang nyo ga gathe da phyosnags la spro// tshe tshad re brgyad bar cad lnga //pho snying na tsha can du 'gyur// 7 me glang 'o/ ba gnyid che zhing // rgyu nor 'phel te shes pa rmongs//tshe tshad ro/na gcig bar chad brgyad// bu skal gcig ldan mo rigs gnyis// nad ni bad rkan 'byung bar rostogs// za sa stag 'o1 ba khengs dregs che// za 'arostod che zhing gasku da la dga'// kha mkhas tshe tshad don gnyis dang // bar chad bdun yod bu skal gnyis// klung zab phyogs nas klu btsan gnod// 7sa yos 'o// ba rig pa cad// kha mang cadar chung yon tan che// tshe tshad lnga bcu bar chad drug/ bu skal gcig dang phung 'khyodad mang // lho gathe nga sogs kyis shi bar dodags// 7 lhags 'brug lo ba nga rgyal che//'byor ldan kha 'jam lus stobs 'phel// god che phyi nang gnyis dar rtsub// gting nag chos la phyi shol che// tshe tshad brgyad cu bar chad gsum// bu skal lnga dang gnod tshabs che// pa lcags sbul 'osto ba dgra yis 'tshe// gzhan mtshang brtag dga' rig pa sna // bajo mkhas pha mar 'acadags yun thung //gag rdzog nyen che spyo 'bog 'byung // tshe tshad don bdun bar chad drug/ bu skal gsum ldan phur gtad gnod// 7 chu rta lo ba rig pa gsal// rang don mi 'chor dpal dang ldan// gzhan skyon bzo zhing khong drang byed// tshe tshad don bdun bar chad brgyad// bu skal bzhi ldan snying rlung 'phyo// rgyal bsen phung 'dres gcad par byed// 7 chu lug lo ba 'a1— la dga'// rgyu nor 'phel zhing shes rab chung //sred che rgyu rdzas bor stor 'byung // tshe tshad don gsum bar chad lnga // bu skal dkon zhing rku jag co nga //ci gnyan gcasnad g.yang nyams byed shi lha gas// 7 shing sprel 'o ba gasku sgyu che// gzugs 〈snabs rgyas shing gdung sems che// mi dge'i 1—gas 'du gnyid chung bzhed// tshe tshad ro na brgyad bar chad bdun// bu skal lnga ldan dgra bo mang // sa bdag rgyal btsan gnod par bsnyad// 7 shing bya 'o/ ba 'khrug rtsod dga'// nye 'brel dgra gyur ga3thong nad che// mdog lhu na tshe tshad drug cu grags//ba skal gsam lan dam sris gcasnad// 7 me khyi 'otho ba spro ring zhing // sems dge nad mang 1—nga khang ra ra tha 73

tshig/ tshe tshad re brgyad bar chad bdun// bu skal gsum ldan sa bdag gcade// 7 me phag pho ba tsha nad ldangan/ gnod mang gzugs ngan tshe tshad ni// re brgyad bar chad bdun du bzhed// bu skal gsum dang gre btsan gnod// 7 sa byi lo la mtshon shi dogs// sems skyonayid drang rang 'dod che//srog gcod la dga' tshe tshad ni// re brgyad bar chad bdun ldan zhes// bu skal gcig bdog sgra shir bsnyad// 7 sa glang pho ba nga bo we// kha smras che zhing lus phung rtsi// g.yo che nor chung tshe tshad ni//lnga bcu'i grangs ldan bar chad bdun// bu skal gcig bdog sa bdag gnod// 5 lcags stag pho ba khro gtum che// rgyu nor gang stongs gtong cad legs// stobs rtsal ldan zhing srog gcad dga'// sha chang rkam tshe ngag tshig rtsub// tshe tshad drug cu bar chad lnga // bu skal bzhi yod rgyal btsan gnodi// 7lcags yos pho ba shes yon ldan// nad mang nor 'phel brtson sems che// tshe tshad re gcig bar chad lnga // bu skal lnga yode bsen mos gnod// 7 chu 'byug lo ba rtsed mor dga'// mkhar gnas mi rtag myur du brje// mtshan sme lus ldan rigs rgyud glen// tshe tshad re gnyis bar chad drug/ bu skal drug yin 'phel 'grib che// 7 chu sgrul 'o ba khengs dregs che// 'aca ra ldan bcang mkhas sems gting nag/ rdzun smra tshe tshad re brgyad la// bar chad mang ste btsan rgyal gnod// 7 shing rta pho ba smra ba mngan/ dad chung grogs dga' shed brtul che// tshe tshad drug cu bar chad gsum// bu skal gcig ldan sa bdag gnode// bad skrun rlung so gas ldang bar grags// 7 shing lug lo ba rig pa gsal// gzugs 〈bes rgyas shing za la dga'// tshe tshad drug tsu bu skal gnyis// bar chad gsum sogs rings su 'byung // 7 me sprel pho ba nga rgyal che// phongs spyodetre brtas shing sred pa che// sho rgyan dga' la rje ca dged// mkhris rlung la sogs nad gzhir byed// tshe tshad re bdun bar chad lnga //bu skal lnga re'ade par bsnyad// 7 me bya lo ba g.yo sgyu che// blo mang 'dod che sdig las brtson// gshis ngan brjed che ngo yang nag/ tshe tshad re lnga bar chad drug/ gri mtshon 'jigs che 'dre gnod brjod//za sa khyi pho ba rtsed mor dga'// nor chung sred che tho gtam mang // rmi lam ngan zhing sgo yang thung //74

tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad bdun// bu skal gsum mam bzhi ldan te// yab mes za 'dres gca da par byed// 7 phag lo ba la rgyu nor 'phel// tshe tshad re bdun bar chad drug/ bu skal gnyis ldan pho 'dre gnod// pa lcags byi 'o/ ba rig pa gsal// dad che lus rgyas gzhan ro na che// rang ro na chung la mdzes nyams ldan// dgrar nyung mthun 'jug kyal ka che// tshe tshad nga bdun bar chad drug/bu skal lnga sogs yod par bzhed// 7 lhags glang lo ba gnyid che zhing // nad gnod nyung zhing bzo rig mkhas// gshis rtsub shes ldan g.yeng ba che// tshe tshad nga lnga bar chad bdun// bu skal gnyis sku da cadags dga' 'byung // 7 chu stag 'o1 ba lus rtsal che// sems nag bstod dga' bud med sred//sems /snan ldan zhing gzhan bcos dka'// tshe tshad dodan gcig bar chad bdun// bu skal gcig ldan rgyu gang rdo ngas// 7 chu sku sa 'o/ ba ser sna che// rgyal gshode gzhan yid mi ches shing // gnyid dga' brjed che dur lha rtsub// tshe tshad don gnyis bar chad gsum// bu skal 'bring tsam zhes su brjod//7 shing 'brug 'osto ba mkhris shas che// 'tho gas bde sdud yangs 'bosto 'dug mang // bzo rig mkhas shing zas nor ldan// ngag 'jam bya mang phrag dog che// tshe tshad re drug bar chad drug/ bu skal nyung zhing chu mig gcadad// 7 shing sprul lo ba rang mjong che// mas snang yas byams rgyu rdzas 'du// ser sna che zhing na tsha nyung // tshe tshad don gnyis bar chad bzhi// bu skal mang ldan rang don tshe// 7 me rta lo ba khengs dregs che// rgyu nor gang stongs grogs la dga'// 'thab dga' blo tshad nad 'ong zhing //khyi rta bsten te gzhan la gca da// tshe tshad 1dun brgyad bu skal gnyis// gre rgyal 11gas kyis gcasted pa 'byung // 7 me lug 'e ba cathor sred che// gzhungs bzang 〉bos rgyas lhag bsam 'grub// dgra mang bu dang tsha bo 'phel// mkhal gcong la sogs gdon gyis gnod// tshe tshad don bdun bar chad bdun// za sa sprel 'o1 ba nga rgyal chung // smra ma/bas 'a1stogs bde rjodad lam legs// bad kun rlung gnod rgyu nor ldan// tshe tshad don brgyad bar chad dgu// bad kun gsum yod rje rigs gnod//za sa bya 'osto ba kha lha thung // chags che phrag ro ga rig pa gsal// ser sna che zhing dbang nyams josgrogs//tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad bdun// bu skal drug yod sa bdag gnod// pa lcags khyi pho ba gnyid che zhing // rgyu nor ldan te bzo rig shes// sems dkar dge 'jug gtam kyang nyung // tshe tshad don 75

bdun bar chad bdun// bu skal gsum ldan chom pos 'jigs// pa lcags phag lo ba dpal 'byor ldan// spyod lam legs kyang 'bul ba'i gnas// tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad bdun// bu skal gnyis sam bzhi ru'abyungan/ 7 chu byi pho ba 'dod pa che// g.yo che sems sun lang tsho ldan// nor brnag tshe tshad don gnyis dang // bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis// zas nor god che gnod cing 'tshe//7 chu glang pho ba rnam g.yeng che// glen zhing gnyid che zhe yang nag/ ngag rtsub tshe tshad bdun cu dang //bar chad bdun yod dur sa'i gnod// 7 shing stag lo ba khro gtum che// 'thab rtsodadaga' zhing phrag dog brtas// ma busar ba 'dug pa 'byung // tshe tshad re drug bar chad lnga // bu skal gsum ldan byi la dga'// mtshan 'gros byed tshe rgyal the'u gnod// 7 shing yos pho ba rang mthong che// grogs la dga' zhing nad dgra mang // blo mang sred che ku re che// tshe tshad don bdun bar chad drug/ bu tsha mang la bse rags gshode// 7 me 'brug 'o/ ba rgyu cadar ldan// lus rgyas srid che rkun dgra gnod//yugs mo 'phrad dogs lag kyang che// rlung mkhris nad sogs skabs ltara'abyungan/ tshe tshadadon gcig bar da bdun// bu skal gnyis yod nor thel gcad// 7 me sbrul lo ba bzo rig mkhas// 'byor ldan nad nyung rje wosto 'gyur// mchosan gri sku gas kyis 'chi bar josnags// lus rgyas shes ldan bsnyen bkur che//tshe tshad doni gcig bar chad bdun// rigs rgyud lnga so/gas sa klus gnod// za sa rta 'o ba cad ba che// nad mang gong 'og kun gyis re// ngag tshig mi brtan bar chad ldang // tshe tshad don lnga bar chad bdun// bu skal gnyis yod sa bdag gnod// za sa lug lo ba rang 'dod che// nang sdang phyi byams dgra yang mang // 'dod chags che zhing skyid sdug 'dres// nga bo che ste tshe tshad ni// drug cu bar chad bzhi ru bsnyad// rkyen ngan mdze gri phur khas gnod// 5 lcags sprel pho ba nor la dga'//yid 'ong dpon rigs gis khar skyid// grib 'byung god che dme bar dogs// tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad brgyad// bu skal lnga sogs ma mo'i gnod// 1 lcags bya lo ba 'dod chags che// nor ldan kun gyi rje bo 'gyur// tshe tshed bdun cu bar chadabadun// bu skal bzhi dang dme 'dres gnod// 7chu khyi pho ba nad dgra 'jigs// sdig la 'bad cing ser sna che// gri mtshon nyen che gong ma sdang // tshe 76

tshad re gsum bu skal nyung // rgyal tho'i 'jigs pa che zhes grags// 7 chu phag 'o ba tho ni yangs//ri nga bo che zhing dpal 'byor ldan// sems brtan phyugs 'khor gtong phod che// tshe tshad drug cu bar chad lnga // bu skal bzhi ldan klu nad g.yengan/ sogs la lhung dogs sa bdag nyen// gong ltar drug cu'i 'o1 rnams la// dbang khams sbyar nas skyes tshang grub// za gsham gsal lus khams skyes tshang bstar// shing ni khong stongaspe ngas su bgrod// myongs spyod gang stongs gong mayis// sa gnyan bcathog pa'i 'gal rkyen gyis// cade la cangargyud sku gas kyang na// sa bdag klu gnyan gnode pas lan//7 me ni srid pa sna 'khyams zhes// nyes skyodan yugs sar bab par byed// pha mes thab gzhobo ri 1—nga bsregs// nyes chad khyod la lus stod na// 'gong btsan riṭa kyis da skabs gnod// za sa ni bye ri sgor mthon zhes// chu mig stor gyi sa rdo bslags// lha rten ci thub blangs soges kyis// gre 'gag kha skugs bad rlung ldang // sa bdag lha sku1gas da skabs gca da// 5 lcags ni nam mkha' 〈snag yangs shing // pha mes gri shi khyod lasang // gri ngo ldang ste dmar 'thab nyen// sngon gyi mes pos dgon dkor blangs// da skabs snying groyan lag na// dkor bdag dme 'dre sogs kyis gnod// 7 chu ci sdug bsngal 'khyil ba zhes// nyon gyi mes pos chu mig khron// bslogs phyir khyod ladabang skyon dogs//mkhal bral na ba'i klu btsan gnod// 7 klung rta'i skyes tshang 'dir bshad bya// byi 'brug sprel gsum lo ba ni// kha smras 'byungayang gnod mi thub// gzhan gyis mi brnyas legs ldan 'phel// 7 ga rta khyi gsum lo ba la// sngongs grogs lha srung dag gis byed// rang nor gzhan gyis 'phrog mi nus//nye du bsod ldan rang dbang bdog/ 7 bya glang sprul gsum lo ba ni// phas sgol phrag dog byed nasang // mthothon skyabs lha yis casangs 1thogs byed// 7 phag lug skustos gsum 'osto ba ni// snga ma'i las bsod zad pa yis// rgyu nor bsgrub kyang phugs mi brtan// 7 ra bzhi rgyal pho 'bring bzhi blone// tha chung bzhi ni sprang le'o// 7 sog lus dbang klung bzhi bo yi// gcade dral kha dmar tabya thā// srog 'byung de yis lus gcod na// pha dang ma yi drin lan ni// chung ste bu sring drin gyis 'tsho// las bya 77

mngasang 'grub pa dkon// sdug bsngal che zhing mi kha snangan/ bskyed na de sdog rabatu dge/ 7 sgog gis dbang thang gcad pa na// sngon bsags pha ku'i rgyu nor rigs// gzhan la 'chol zhing g.yang sogs nyams// za bskyedaka de lasalhasag pacas// 7 sgog gis klung rta gcod pa na// nye du'i phyogs la dar gud mngan/ lus rten gcig la sdug skyid zungan/ srog gi rlung bskyed de las sdog/ lus kyis srog la gcade pa na// phyugs rigs bsad phyir lus skyon dogs// byis dus 'tsho dka'aye 'brog che// lus srog bskyedapa de las sdog/ lus kyis dbang thang la gcad na// byes su bgrod na gang stongasa'abyungan/ phyugs shod che zhing rigs rgyud gshod// za bskyed na natu bzang zhes brjod// 7lus kyis rlung rta la gcad na// nye du dgrar ldang gzhan layangan/ phan byas tshur la gnod skyon dogs// 7 lus kyis rlung rta bskyed na shis// za dbang thang lus gcad mi langan// lha min 'gong 'dre sogs kyis gnod// 7 dbang thang srog gcad rigs rgyud la// dbang bo mi tshang nad rigs ldang // dbang thang klung rta la gcad na// mes rigasadapalatamasakhi smras 'byungan/ bskyed na dge mtshan kun la che// 7 dbang 1—ga gnyis kyis lus gcade na// ris/sa rgyud kun kyang 'chos dka' ca //srog lus gnyis kyis dbang thang gcod// rang rgyu phongs shing pha dpal ldan// rgyu rdzas gang stongs phyis gasku 'a1sto// 7 dbang 1thog gnyis kyis klung rta gcade// 'ar+shasna nad sku gas kyis nyes 11na che// klung rtas lus gcod rigs rgyud phongs// 'og gags skyes tshang spyi bye rnams// khadamar gnad bsdus grub zin to// lha gnyis pa spar kha'i skyes tshang ni// btsas le'i ma yi spar 'dri nas// legs nyes kha dmar gsham du gsal// 7 gli jog btsas pa'i skyes bu de// pha mes brgyud de mtshon khar nyen//mo rigs yin na byis 'jur 'byung // gzhob grib sogs la ma 'dzem na// nad rigs nyes skyon 'ong nyen che// gnod byed lha 'gong sa bdag go/ 7 khon steng skyes pa 'khon 'dzin che// khro gtum bcos dka' gang stongs che// ngag 'jam pha mes dur skyon gyis// zha phong sgrun skugs rigs ngan 'ongan/ sems brtan nad sdang gtsang sbra che// lha dang klu sman rigs sogs gnod// 7 da steng 78

skyes pa khong khro che// snying stobs drag rtsal stobs kyang che// sems pa dkar zhing nye du'i phyogs//mna' zos mtshon gyis shi dogs yod// rgyu nor gang stongs lha btsan gnod// spre khen jog gang skyes khengs dregs che// gang stongs skyid sdug thabs shes che// dga' byas mgu nyung 'gong rgyal gnod//dgra sna yul la 'asgyu 'gyur 'byung // 7 kham ste gang skyes sems gting nag/ snu maca rwang phyo gas dma' bar grags// nang rtsub phyi 'jam gnyen 'grig dka'// sngon mes btsog mnol nalagyi gos//rigs rgyud nal caste mdza' mthun la// byed bral mang phyir lha klu bsen// 7 gin steng gang skyes lus lci zhing // sems brtan smra nyung gzhan bathe sa dka'// sems dam rags cing phra la zhib// ྅ne mes rgyud kyis mdze gnyan nad// mang ste dgra lha sa thel gnod// za zin steng gang skyes g.yo sgyu che//smra mang thabs mkhas za thang che// sngo mdog lag g.yang khyim nang gyong // lha ni yul lha ming 'dre gnod// 4 zon steng gang skyes 'gran sems che// khro dga' 'phya 'dod mtho gnod che// phyis su rings par nad ngo che// nyon mes cad gtong rbad 'dres 'gras// rgyal 'gong gnod phyir 'chi rkyen byas// de sku gas spar kha'i skyes tshang grub// za gsum pa smre ba'i skyes tshang ni// gcig dkar la skyes blo sna mang // lhas byin dge dad sems pa dkar// rkang mgyogs rgyu nor gang cu ngas che// 'gro dga' 'dug la mi dga' zhing // btsog rigs la ni shin tu snar// mo rigs yin phyir skyed pu bgrang //nang khyim 'gong rigs chags par brjod// mtshan rtags lus smad sme sha mdzer// gang rung yod pas lha klu'akhor// phyugs rigs 'phrad cing tshe tshad ni// don gcig dge spyod spyan gzigs sam// gshen lha 'od dkar sku bzhengs na// 'byor ldan mi lus thob par bzhed// de min gnod spyin the'u rang skye//za gnyis nag la skyes gnyid che zhing // nad nyung dmyal 'phos bdud kyi bu// zhe nag nang rtsub phyi la 'jam// pha ma bral snga mna' za bas// khyim sku len grangs mang ba 'byung // rigs rgyud sku gas kyang masgyu rwadogasapas// lcags sran bsgril 'drar gcode mi 'gyur// phas 〉stol byad khas shes lha1na bral// tshe nyonagashod sbyin bdudadu skyes// rtags mtshan cib logs g.yas g.yon dngan/ smosasha mtshanayod 79

pa ra grags// ban thon gangayin mthu rtsal che// lha bdud sgra bla sogs kyang 'kho ra// rgyal ba'i skudang mchod rten bzhengs// ma 'ongs dge spyod bgyis pa na// zhang blon rigs bzang skye bar bsnyad// de min dom sprel gang rung skye// 7 gsum mthing la skyes rang malnga nga che// stobs che sems brtan las bya nyung // rdzun chung klu bsen gnyan gyi bu// skye nyo na glang bo zhig tu skyes// rtags kyang glang nyal glang langs byed// gachodags g.yas sme ba sha mtshan mo da// rnam dkar dge cadags mchodad sbyin dang // yig brgya gang mang shod ra sems sam// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku bzhings na // nub tso gas rigs bzang yang dag skye// de min srin po'i lus lan cardongs// za bzhi ljang la skyes sems cadabs che// klus byin skad 'phra skra 'jam zhingan/ blo rgya che ste btsog rigs sdar// skye sngon klur skyes rtags mtshan du// lus stod g.yas g.yon phyogs de la// sme ba yod cing lha klu 'khor// nor ni zal bo sngon por 'phrad// ma 'ongs dge spyod bgyis pa dang // rnam 'joms sku dang phyag rdor rigs// sāts+tsha khri 'bum btab pa na//sngags nus can du skye bar 'gyur// de min byol song skye bar dogs// tshe tshad re lnga thob par bsnyad//sa bdag gnyan sku gas gcathod pa yis// mcho na gri ldang la bu tsha bzhi// klu gnas cadags su rgyu ba spang //7 lnga ser gang skyes yul lha'i bu// sems brtan dge dad yig rtsis shes// rig gsal 'a11dga' bsgrub brtson bzangan/ tshe cadan ban de'am mi dbang skyes// rtags mtshan rkang spyi gang rung la// sme yod tshe tshad nga gnyis dngan/ pha mes lha dang yul lha 'khor// ma 'ongagadage bsgrub sangs rgyas sku//skye sgo gcod pa'am rdor gcad sogs// bzhengs bsgrub byed na rigs bzang skye// de min sprel sprul skye bar ro/gas// 7 drug dkar la skyes shes rab che// lha 'bo nga sgra blas byin kyang zer// grags che kha 'jam gtingasang rtsub// gzhan la yid ches tshur mthong che// rangayid dpung 'dzugs don mi 'chor//tshe 1—na bram ze'am thoni gshen skyes// rtags mtshan bden smra doni gyisa'ibakur// lha rigs shā1 lha skuthogs kyang 'khor// ca ra ni dmar zal 'phrad pa yin// tshe tshad bdun cu keg lnga bdog/ rigs rgyud gsum snye dang lnga gang rung // ma 'ongs dge spyod mdo sde klo'i// rtsaba'i bla ma'i sku bzhing na// lto dang yang na 80

byang nub tu// rigs bzang shes yon can du skye// de min bya dang 'gong bor skye// gtsugator gdugs dkar rim gro bya// 7 bdun dmar la skyes blo sna mang // btsan bu yin zhing srog gcod dga'// spro thung sting chung smra mkhas shing // rgyu nor gang stongs dme 'khrug 'ongan/ mo rigs pho dang pho rnams mo// dad che rang nyid gri 'chir nyen// 'grang ltogs mgar ba'i sbud pa bzhin// bde sdug dpyid ma'i nyi mkha'adra// tshe lhungan lha ma yin la skyes// rtags mtshan gazlo gas g.yas lag gamo na dag/sme spu sha mtshan gang rung yod// lha btsan grogs byed dpa' rtsal ldan// rgyu nor dkar dmar gnyis 'phrod zer// ma 'ongs dge spyod sgrol sku 'am// dbyings kyi yum chen skur bzhings na// 'dul 'dzin bla ma zhig tu skye// de min yi dwags 'phar spyang sogs// gang rung zhig tu skye bar bzhed// 7brgyad dkar la skyes shes rab che// dga' ldan lhas byin ngag tshig 'jam// tshe mjug skyid la kun gyis bkur// rtags su gcaṭags g.yas sme ba sku da// batherag rigs sku gas lashinatu sdar// lha dang rgyal po'i rigs kyang 'khor// don med la yang gtam 'chol bshad// tshe tshad lnga bcu bar chad gsum// phyi ma mo rigs lus len ro gas// ma co ngas dge brtson 'bum sde ca gas// sgo na pa'i sku masnu ga bzhengs pa na// lha baX skyo'am lha lus len// 7 dgu dmar gang skyes phrag lha ga che// lha las 'phos shing gnam sman byin// donachen mi 'chor ser sna che// tshe stod nor 'phel tshe smadasangan/skye cadan 'acadar ldan sgocir skyeg/ rtags mtshan ske la sme ba snang // lha btsan sman mo'i rigs kyang 'kho ra// rgyu cadar phyugs sogs 'phradapar bzhedaka g.yang nyams nags gnas 'dre gdon gnode//tshe tshad don gsum bar chad lnga // ma 'ongasadage spyod tshe gzungs klogs// shes rab lha mchog sbu bzhings na// lto phyogs mon yul 'byor ldan skye// de min byol song skye bar dogs// spre ba'i skyes tshang kha dmar grub// lha bzhi babakha' yi skyes tshang ni// 7 nyi ma la skyesakag bdun dngan/ zla bdun 'tsho na tshe ring 'gyur// gong mas byams shing rigs rgyud phyug/ khyim so 'dren zhes bzhed paspe/da//7 zla ba la skyes mdzes nyams che// bu skyes btsan phyug 'acasams zhes grags// 7 mig dmar sna1 81

skyes nada'achi dogs// bu skyes spro thung mi dge spyod// 7 lhag par mo sa pha mar phongs mo nyid za thang 'phel ba 'ongan/ bu skyes ma la rtsub pa dngan/ kho rang na tsha sogs kyis na// 7 phur bu mo skyes bzang grogs dge/ bu skyes shes ldan gdung mdangs zhan// 7 pa sangs mo sa nad rigs 'byung / bu skyes rig gsal tshe yang ring / tsho spen pa dpal chung gzugs bzang zer// mo snags tshe thung pho la 'bri ngan/ gza' bdun skyes tshang bsnyad nas grub// lha lnga ba skar ma'i skyes tshangani//7 tha skar gang skyes gzugs bzang zhing / glu gar la dga' cadal char mkhas// dgedad smra mkhas brgyad cu thub// 'gro dga' sems ni mi brtan zer// 7 bra nyer la skyes lag batho shes// bden smra nad med sems mi brtan// snying rje chung zhing phyi ma ni// ngan song skye dogs lo sku/ drug/ yang na gosnga gang rung thub// pa smin drug gang skyes dpal 'byor ldan// gzi brjid che zhing mkhas snyan grags//mo rigs la chags tshe stode ngan// tshe smad legs kyang tshe tshad ring // 7 snar ma la skyes gzugs bzang zhingag/ 'byor ldan g.yo chung sbyin la dga'// shes ldan ngag 'jamadagra dpung 'joms// tshe ringadapal ldan dge tshogasa'iphel// 7 mgo la gang skyes rig pa gsal// dpal ldan bden smra sems kyang brtan//gzhan la dga' zhing sdom brtson ldan// nyer brgyad dgu bcu gang rung thub// 7 lag la gang skyes dpal 'byor ldan// g.yo can sdig pa'i las la dga'// nga rgyal che zhing re lnga'am// so lnga gang rung 'tsho bar bzhed// nam zhig 'go nad cig gis 'chi// 7 nabs so gang skyes dpal 'byor ldan//sems bzang smra mkhas tshul khrims ldan// then zhing sems brtan nad rigasatwangan/ lnga bcusang na drug cu thub// 7 rgyal la gang skyes tshul khrims ldan// gzugs bzang smra mkhas zhi dul bzangan/'gro dga' sbyin gtong tho mi brtan// shes ldanacadaradabang snyan grags bdog/ 7 lhagasngagang skyes sred pa che// jigadad legegange 'itshul khrimasa'achal// stengasngonegos byadaman rigs brtson//bzhin mdzes ma la'igrogesayun thungan/ lnga bcu'am ni re gsum 'chos// za mchu la gang skyes rgyu nor ldan// rigs rgyud bzo mkhas dge bar brtson// rdzun tshig la dga' nyer 'khor mang //82

pho skyes pha la ngan zhes dang // mo hūs mo rang 'chi bar byed// lnga bcu go lnga gang dag 'tsho// 7 gro la gang skyes ser sna che// bzo mkhas ngag 'jam g.yo sgyu mang // mdzes chos la dga' rang gshis ngan// r+sha hūs 'chi dogs spyod lam cing // mo hūs ma la ngan zhes grags// pho brgyad ma shi nga bzhi'am// go lnga gang rigs 'tsho thub bzhed// 7 dbo la gang skyes myongs spyod ldan// bden smra 'gro dga' tshul khrims gtsang // glen zhing dug 'chi sbyin gtong dga'// rkyen ngan bzlog tshe tshe ring bsnyad// 7 me bzhi la skyes gasku sgyu che// gzugs bzang 'acadar ldan sdod mi tshugs// tshul khrims srung 'i/nga smrar lce bde// blo lus mi bde lag pa gzob// brgyad cu dag la 'tsho zhes 'dod// 7 nag pa la skyes 'aro da chags che// lus dbang leṭa shing glu rol mkhas// ngag rtsub rig gsal sgra mkhas grags// rdzun chung chas gos rigs mang gyon// nyer brgyad 'tsho res yun du gnas// za sa ri la skyes kha smras che// 'asdudar ldan mas sdang yas byams shingan/ ser sna che zhing chang la dga'// sems rtsing bden smra bzhin legs shing // dge spyod nyi shu'am drug cu 'tsho// za sa gar gang skyes phrag dog che/ /dpal dang gzi brjid nor sogs ldan// dpal thul shes ldan slo rigs 'du// bdun cu 'tsho zhing tshe smad bzang // 7 lha mtshams la skyes dge spyod 'tsho// nor ldan tshig 'jam byes 'gro bzang //khrim sa gtsang shes ldan gzugs bzang zhing // nyer brgyad 'cho dpes yun du gnas// 7 1ston la gang skyes snying rje chung // sdig las brtson zhing khrims 'chal byed// gzhan la sdug gtong bzang d+me byed// — —— noraphongs/ so lnga 'tsho ༄sa ring // 7 lhab slo gang skyes nga rgyal che// sdig las brtson dga' rigs h+phu da nyung // so/ lnga'am ni re gsum 'tsho// 7 chu stod 'a/ skyes sbyin gtong dga'// dge ldan bzo mkhas nga rgyal che// khrim sa ldan ma/tho ris 1—ba ces bzhed// brgyad cu 'cho danas skudangs su grags// 7 chu smad la skyes shes rab che// tshe ring nor ldan sbyin gtong byed// bden smra byams ldan bu grogs mang //baX 6 sukhas/ nad dathosan tsha nad lhusags// 7 byi bzhin la skyes sems 〈snags dkar// casar ldan nad dkon dge la spyod// 'gro dga' 'khor skyong blo rgya che// gnyen dga' bzod ldan snyan grags 'phel//83

drug cu 'am ni re gnyis 'tsho// 7 gro bzhin la skyes shes rab che// nor ldan spro thung dgra 'dul mkhas// bsam bzang nad dasnodan sred pa chung // 〈thobs ldan 'acad dga' gzhan gyis bkur// drug cu 'tsho zhing yongs su bzhed// 7 mon dre la skyes bu nor ldan// bsam bzang 'byor ldan bag yangs rtsom// mo btsas mdzes ldan smra ba mkhas// blo cing nam zhig chu yis 'chi// nyer lnga 'am ni drug cu 'tsho// 7 mon gyur gang skyes gtong phod ldan// gzugs bzang gnyid che bab col che// stobs dang god ldanadaka' thub dga'// rings 'chi ma shi nang mis byams// 7 khrums stod gang skyes nor la spyod// rku gsode g.yo sgyu spro ba dang // phyi mi sdang zhing gnyen la bsgo/ gshis ngan dmag chodam sems kyang blun// grags che rna gsang dbang ldan 'gyur// go lnga 'tsho shes yang yang bcadad// 7 khrums smad la skyes mchodad sbyin byed// khrims ldan smra mkhas snying rje ldan// bden smra gar mkhas 'khe ra mang 'du// dgra las rnam rgyal shes rab ldan// lnga bcu 'am ni drug cu 'tsho // 7 nam gru la skyes 'bru nor ldan// gzhan rnams dga' zhing shin tu legs// dbang skyon skye bo mdzangs mang ldan// rin chen la spyod spro ba mngan/ nyer brgyad dam ni dgu bcu 'tsho// skar ma'i skyes tshang legs par grub// ༈drug pa khyim gyi skyes tshang ni// lug khyim gang skyes 'aro da chags che// 'ong zla zhag sku gas bcu bcu dang //sum cur ma 'chi 'o mang 'cho // rjod thung 'khe ra mang ngag tshig (rajam// zhing dga' kun shes rgyal cadas mnyostod// smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum// yang na res gza' mig dmar nyin// me dgras nam phyed 'chi bar sho gas// 7 glang khyim gang skyes snyan grags che// 'kho ra mang shes ldan bad mkhrisarigs// nad kyis dgun ra mig dmar gyi// dgong mo 'chi ro/gas mig cadamar// g.yeng ba che zhes las bya dka'// za 'khrig khyim gang skyes ltad mor dga'// chags che chang dga' cadar ldan bsnyad//zhag zla lnga lnga lo nyer lngar// ma shi rigs bzang go lnga 'tsho// gsong smra rgyal zla'i gza' lhag pa// bcu drug snga sdu ra mtshon 'chi dodags// 7 ka/ la skyes byams sems ldan// shes rab che zhing 〈snabs dang ldan// 'o/ zla zhag lnga bdun bcu drug/ sum cu dag la ma shi na// brgyad cu 'tsho zhes kun la grags//84

snron zla'i res gza' pa sangs nyin// nyi rgas dmu chu nad kyis 'chi// 'a1— dga' dge cadags la ni dad / 7 seng khyim gang skyes nga rgyal che// gzugs bzang stobs ldan nad mang zhingan/ chang dga' cal che mchod sbyin dga'// gang skyes bcu gsum lo zla zhag/ ma shi don dgu 'etsho bar grags//mar ngo bya ma spen nyin gyi// phyed yol rdib 'og 'chi bar bzhed// 7 bu mo'i khyim la gang skyes pa//nor dbang che zhing bu mang btsas// nyer dgu'i zhag dang zla phyed bcu// myo ni nyeradagu ma shin// drug cu'i bar 'phyo kunadang mthun// mkhas shing tshes lnga bya'u spen shin// mgotad mtshan mor 'chi bar grags//7 srang khyim gang skyes tshig rtsub smra// khong khro nga rgyal gtsang sbra che// gang skyes zla zhag lngalngadangan/ rang lonyi shur ma 'chi na// brgyad cu 'tsho zhing sond 'byungan/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshesabargyad kyi// sgar sgrog mig dmar 'dus nad kyis// thun gsum mtshan mor 'chi zhes bshad// 7 jig khyim gang skyes 'khrug las dga'// 'o1 zla zhag songags bcu bcu la// ma 'chi lngabacu 'tsho zhes bcade// dbyar 'bringasar tsho'i mig dmar nyin// zla skar bya ljoldogu la// skrang 'bur nad kyis snga dro 'chi// za gzhu khyim gang skyes tshul khrims ldan// bden smra 'byor ldan sbyin gtong dga'// gang skyes lo zla zhag bco brgyad// grangs la ma 'chi bdun cur 'tsho// dgun ra'i bco lnga'i skar khrums res// rims mtshon gyis ni phyi sdu ce//7 chu srin khyim la gang skyes pa// dpa' zhing chags che lta na sdug/ dri sgos glu dang rol rtsed dga'//gzi brjid che zhing rgyal bos mchod// gang skyes pho zla zhag bco brgyad// ma 'chi don brgyad 'pho bar bshad// 1sto zla'i ba〉tho lnga gza' spen gyi// nyin phyed sgo nga la skran gyis 'chi// 7 bum khyim gang skyes nga rgyal che// 'khosgror mang dpal 'khyodar snyan grags ldan// bathesto brgyad thothong ltar ma 'chi na// dbyar 'bring tshes ni bcu gnyis la// gre dang gza' ni nyi shar dus// bad mkhris nad kyis 'chi zhes bshad//shes ldan gzhan phan che bar grags// 7 3khyim gang skyes ser sna che// 'byor ldan sha srid 'khrig 'didaga'// za thang ldan kyang phan pa chung // 'orwagrangs bcu gnyis nyin bather+sha brgyad// ma 'chi bo lnga 'tsho zhes grags// khrumasadabyug zla ba'idakar cadags la// bcu gnyis tshes kyis skar sbedangan/ gza' 85

phur nyin la rlung nad kyis// phyed yos dus su 'chi zhes bcadad// khyim kyi skyes tshang brjod kyis grub//lha bdun pa rten 'brel skyes tshang ni// za ma rig la skyes 'khrig sred che// ཿ swā ngas nye du nang rtsod dga'// 'byor ldan smra mang sdug bsngal byed// rtsis rig shes sla gya bzhir 'tsho// 'du byed nyi mar 'chi bar ho gas// 7 'du byed la skyes tshig mi brtan// bzo mkhas chang dga' blo gas po mngan/'acad dga' ca ra 'du brtan mi chags// gya gcig 'tsho zhing rnam shes nyin// 'chi zhes gzhung chen dag las brjod// 7 rnam shes la skyes nga rgyal che// tshig rtsub blo sna sdig spyod 'phel// nor phongs sgobs ldan re bzhir 'tsho// ming gzugs nyin mor gri shir dogs// 7 ming gzugs la skyes bu nor dkon// chung ma gsum ldan dgra sdang mang // khengs dregs che zhing gya gcig 'tsho// pha mar tshe thung tshe smad phyug/ tshong gis 'tsho zhing skye mched nyin// gcong nad sogs kyis 'chi bar bshad// 7 skye mched la skyes ser sna che// dbul 'o/ngas 'o/ bcur ma 'chi na// nad mang rkam che re ba'i thub// reg pa rang khyim thogatu 'chi// 7 reg pa la skyes nga rgyal che// shes ldan rku byed phrag dog ldan// nor ldan sred che ngag tshig 'jam// re gsum 'tsho zhing tshosar nyin 'chi// 7 tshor ba la skyes gzhan gyis bkur // nad mang bzo mkhas rtsing spyod dga'// nor 'phel chung ma gnyis ldan zhing // re gsum 'tsho zhing sred nyin 'chi// 7 khrod par gang skyes gzugs bzang zhing // 'byor ldan nad nyung dgra grogs mang // rigs rgyud mang zhing gya bzhir 'tsho// len nyin dug gis 'chi bar bshad// 7 len pa la skyes gaskud 'alha da che// tshul khrims 'chal zhing kha smras mang // gzhan bslu sems ༄/da re bzhir thub// srid nyin mdze 'am chu yis 'chi// za srid pa la skyesabacad las mkhas// baX mkhas cathor ldan gnyid chung brjid// gzhan gyi chung mar chags spyod byed// drug cur 'tsho zhing skye nyin 'chi//7 skye bar gang skyes sgyur rtsal ldan// nye 'khor mi skyong bden smra legs// mchod 'os gnas gyur nor gud che// bdun cur 'tsho zhing rga shi'i nyin// chu yis 'jigs shing 'chi bar byed// 7 rga shir gang skyes gnyen la byams// byis dus nad mang sdig las dga'// re bzhir 'tsho zhing ma rig nyin//86

gri mtshon sogs kyi 'chi bar byed// rten 'brel skyes tshang legs par grub// lha brgyad pa tshes kyis skyes tshang ni// 7 tshes gcig rigs rgyud gang skyes kyang // shes rab gsal zhing brjid chags shing // tshes gnyis gang skyes mo rigs zhan// tshes gsum gang skyes 'chi bar bshad// tshes bzhi gang skyes ma la nyen// tshes lngar gang skyes pho rigs bzang // tshes drug gang skyes slar yang bstud//tshes bdun gang skyes pho shes gsal// tshes brgyad gang skyes 'tsho dka' bzhed// tshes dgur gang skyes byur bu grags// tshes bcur gang skyes dbul zhing phongs// bcu gcig bstud skye blo rig gsal//bcu gnyis gang skyes pho rig gsal// bcu gsum gang skyes shin tu zhan// bcu bzhir gang skyes pha mar ngan// bco lngar gang skyes 'byor ldan bzang // bcu drug gang skyes phyis btud yong // bcu bdun gang skyes pho rig gsal// bco brgyad gang skyes 'pho bar dka'// bcu dgur gang skyes byur bu bdog/ nyi shur gang skyes phongs bar byed// nyer gcig gang skyes slar mthud skye// nyer gnyis gang skyes pho rigs bzang // nyer gsum gang skyes 'chi bar nyen// nyer bzhir gang skyes mar ngan bshad// nyer lngar gang skyes pho rigs phyug/ nyer drug gang skyes slar yang bskud// nyer bdun gang skyes pho rig gsal// nyer brgyad gang skyes 'tsho bar dka'// nyer dgu gang skyes byur bu yin//ba /nam gang la skyes dbul phongs so// tshes kyi skyes tshang gnad bsdus grub// ces rtsis rig shes bya kun gsal las tshe rabs las rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pacad// 87

༄༅༅/ /legs legs lnga rig rin chen 'byung gnas la//mtshar mtshar dbyig gi mosnan tan phul tu phyin//mkhas mkhas mtshan snyan dbyar rnga ldir ba can //yang yang sdu/ba dawa na masnu ga la gus btud nas//skye dgu mchog dman bar gsum gyi//bde skyid rten 'brel brtag pa'i rtsis//rgya nag dpyad lding bcu gsum 'di//lung dang rigs pa bsdebs nas 'chad//lha dang bo mi rje rgyal dze la// bya rgyal khyung gi lding cadar zhes// bcingabya'i khams gyi dgra bya nas//barmabya du lon gyen bgrang pa'i// srog lus dbang klung skyes spe lngar// brtsibya'i de lngas 'thab pas ga //ma groṭa sa chu nang 'phrad dkar// bu dgra shing lcaṭa me nang nag/ de yang rtsis 'go rnam pa lnga // rgyal rabs gdan sa stongs ma stongs// stag gzig grwa 'dzum yal ma yal// chab srid dar mdud cadal ma grol// pho brang mi la shor ma shor// zhwa phying rdul 'og song ma song // lha dang po srog gi del lhadakar na// rgyal po'i rgyal rabs mi 'chad cing // chab srid gdan sa 〉stongs mi srid// snarwa rngo'i brag bzhin sku tshe brtan// nag na rgyal dang rgyal sras la// pha mes sa nas dur sri langs// 11gas med thodan gshen lngas sri 'dul// sku ga bslu rgyal wa gdan bzhugs bya// 7 lus shel dkar na nad dang bral// stag gzig grwa 'dzum btsun ro/ra dge/ snang srid zil gcasnan rgyal bu 'khrungs// chab srid thams cad bde la 'khengad// nag na rgyal 11 snyung gzhis zin// ya/ba sras btsun 31 kha 'bral ca da// rgyal srid ston chu bzhin du 'bri// sbyin gtong lus bsgyur sdom pa sungs / ṣ+ka dbang del dkar na'o/ngas spyod rgyas// chab srid dar mdud ma 11la bas// (thugs gnyis ma nga' thangs rgyas te bzang // nag na mi rje gzhan gyis 'phya// bu rta nor phyuṭa longs spyod 'bul// g.yang len dpal bstod bka' 'gyur klogs//88

lha klung der dkar na rgyal bo yi// pho brang mi la ma ཿthor bas// snyan graṭa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng // sdudan dang 'bangs gyis gang gsung sgrubs// nag na rgyal srid rlung gis g.yeng // rgyal khams mi bde rgyal khab rtsod// rlung gso dgra mnan sbyin 'gyed soṭa// rim gro stobs chen myur du 'bod//5 smi del dkar na zhwa phying de// rdul 'og ma song btsad po yi// bka' btsan riṭa brgyud dar bas bzang // nag na rgyal po'i mnga' ris la// nad mtshoni mu ge'i bskal ba dar// drag sngags ma tsho'i spyi mdos gces// lha gnyis pa gshen rgyal bon po la// g.yu 'brug sngon mo 3nga sgor zhes// brtsobya'i khams/ gyi me 'brug nas// gyen bgrang 'thab pa'i rtsis 'go lnga // dbu yi gtsugato/ra mtho mi mtho//gzi brjid mtshan dpe bkrag mi bkrag/ gser gyi rnga gshang snyan mi snyan// g.yung drung khri 'phang brtan mi brtan// bskyed rdzoṭa ting 'dzin gsal mi gsal// lha dang wa gyeg gi del dkar na// bon gshen dbu 'phang dgung las ma1—// bshad sgrub nyi zla mkha' la gsal// brgyud 'dzin gshen po'i sku tshe ring // bon dar mtha' dbus kunatu dar// nag na gtsug tor sprin gyis sgrib// sgrub brgyud gshen po'i sku tshe thung // lha sung bsnyen sgrub tshegayang khugs// sgyu lus shel dkar na bkrag mdangs rgyas// nad galhasan ma bzhes mtshan dpe gsal// gshen brgyud mi 'chad chu las ring // nag na gzi brjid zla ba la// nad gajothon sgra bcan gdug pas gathongs// gsas mkhar gnyen po'i dbang chen zhu// lha dbang del dkar na rnga gshang sgra// stong khams srid pa gsum du grags// lha 'dre kun la bka' btsan zhing // skye 'gro sku ngas la phan cadaṭa 'byung // nag na rnga gshang btsa' yis khyer//skyes bu'i dam tshig la sel zhugs// nyams chags bskang zhing phywa g.yang 'bod// 5 rlung del dkar na sgrub gshen nyid// zhabs pad g.yung drung khri 'phang brgyud// snyan graṭa gdul bya phyoṭa bcur rgyas//'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// nag na skyobos pa'i lha 'khu ba'i// mar+shasto gsum marostos dang bdud bsgog bya// 5 smi shel dkar na lha gshen de// lta ba nam mkha' bzhin du mjo// lha ma pa nyi zla bzhin du gsal// dam tshig shel ltar dri ma med// nag na bon brgyud dar gud che// phas gyi mthu gtad thod gtongalod// phyogs bzhir bzlog chen bya bar shes// lha gsum pa bshes gnyen ban de la//seng ge dkar mo'i sding sgostor zhes// brtsi bya'i khams kyi dgra yostos nas// gye bgrangs 'thab pa'i 89

rtsis 'go lnga // gser rdor gnam du yar masngar// bum pa phyag nas shor ma shor// shel dkar phreng thag chad ma chad// g.yu yi man ḍal grum ma grum// seng ge'i khri mang zhig ma zhig/ lha dang wa 31ga gi del dkar na// gser rdor nam khar ma yal bas// 'chi med grub pa'i lang chos brnyes//snang srid dbang du 'dus pa yin// nag na tshe la bar chad 'byung // nus pa phul du cha/ phyin pas//bsnyen sgrub las 'bad yang dag bya// zha lus del dkar na rin chem gyi// bus/phyasanasamashon cingan/ ngur smrig chothos gos mdangs bcas bzang // nag na sku la snyung gzhi bzhes// gdul bya skal dman chos rgyud thungan/ sku lus bsgyur zhing sdom pa bskyal// ༈ dbang del dkar na sher dkar gyi// phreng thag ma chad zab don 'byin// bu slobo longs spyod dar rgyas 'phel// nag na phrin las mi da ra zhing // gzhan phan mdzad la bar chad 'byung // dbang zhu bzlas bcad zas nor sbyin// lha drung del dkar na bkra shis pa'i// maṇa ḍal ma grum gdul bya dar// snyan grags yone tan medodag bzhad//nag na gdul byas gshe skur 'debs// phrin las ba dan gudapas na// chose stone lam bsal rten gsum mchode// lha 1 deladakaran seng ge'i khri// ma lhonges byin rlabs chu rgyun 'thebs// bstan pa cadags bcuradar bas bzangan/ nag na bzhugasayul 'ar+sha skyes 'byungan/ bstan dang satshe bar chad ngo // sgrub chen bka' brgyad rten bzhugs bya// lha bzhi pa sngags 'chang dam ldan la// gser sbrul ser wa'i lding sgor zhes// brtsobya'i khams kyi groṭa sbul nas// gyen bkan 'thab pa'i ces 'go lnga // ting 'dzin dgongs pa grol ma1 la// thams cad 'do gsal sgrib ma bsgrib// dkyi/la 'kho ra bkrag mdangs yal ma yal// phur pa'i dbal rtsebardugs ma bdugs// mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad sostong mi 'ong ༈dang wa ༄rmeg gi rdel dkar na// ting 'dzin dgongs pa ma grol ba'i// za bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mngon du phebs// brjid ldan brgyud bzang sku tshe ring // nag na rnal 'byor dgongs pa yengs// dam tshig skyon zhuṭa brgyud 'dzin 'chad// srog la bar chad 'byung srid pas// bsnyen sgrub dam tshig gso sbyong bya// 5 lus del dkar na brgyud 'dzin bzang // thams cad casad gsal gsal sgrib me da// snang srid dbang 'dus snyun las 11la// nag na 'ode ba/sal 'thibs gyis sgrib// nus pa mi 11na nad gyis gzir// yi dam skur bzhengs tshogs 'kho ri bya// ska dbang de'/ dkar na dkyil 'khosgror gyi// bkrags sbyo/(/

mdangs ma yal sngags brgyud bzang // sde brgyad 'byung 1sto bran du 'khol// zhing bcu bsgu na la zin pas bzang // nag na sngags brgyud shin tu ngan// pha yis brag la phur btab kyang // bu yis mar la zug mi 'gyur// nus mthu mi 〈snan sgrub khang lha ngas// sgrub gnas spo zhing drag sngags bcadan// ༈rlung del dkar na phur ba yi// dbar rtsem dugs ngar dang ldan// mngon spyod las myur snyan grags ldan// nag na byad phur jo da galta nga 'o/ga/ mi kha gleng gzhi 'du ba yin// bsdudag pa gtad baspyodal mi kha bsgyur// ga sme rdel dkar na mkha' 'acad mas// bka' chad mi 'byung rig pa 'dzin// mkha' la nyi ma shar dang 'dra// nag na rig 'dzin sa mi non// bsku/ dang phaṭaḥgyi sgra nyams pas// yi dam lha bsten srung ma sgran// lha lnga pa zhang blon du ma la// rab brtan glang po'i lding sgor zhes// brtsibya'i khams kyi bo gas glang nas// gyen bgrang 'thab pa'i rtsis 'thod lnga // rje yi thung brtse bral ma bral//lha yi bka' chad 'byung mi 'byung // yid tshang gser g.yu shor ma shoraka/ 'phrul gyi mdang mdung chag ma chag/ 11na wa'i 'dun sa rjodangs ma lha ngas// lha dang wa srog gi del dkar na// rgyal gyi thugs brtses ma gtong bas// blon gyi sdu༄ 1sa zad mi shes// chab 'bangs bde zhing bar chad med// nag na blon gyi phrin las gud// las bzhag mi zin tshe yang thung // 'bum dang dgra ba11ga dgra sri mnan// ༈ gus del dkar na yi dam lhas// bka' chad mi 'byung mgon skyob byed// blon brgyud dar zhing rgyab brten bzang // nag na nad masnuton bar chad cad // lha gasku la sri mnan sri srung 'jothogs// lha dbang rdel dkar na yid tshang gi/ rin chen bang mdzod ma shor bas// zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu 'phel//nag na yid tshang gser g.yu stongs// ska dang po dar yang tha mar gud// gser 'od rnam rgyal phywa g.yang len// 5 rlung del dkar na dpa' bo yi// 'phrul gyi mda' mdung ma chag pas// tshe ring nad dato/na bsam ro na 'grub// nag na tshe la bar chad 'byung // pha khu rang gsum bla 'khyams pas//bla bslu dgra bla'i dpang bstod bya// ga sme shel dkar na blon po yi// 'dun sa ma stongs snyan grags che// chab srid lhu 1sa thabs gyis skyodangs// nag na mi kha mi 〈snag 'byung // sdu na wa'i khro nyes rgyal gyis bakhyodan// mdo rgyud gzungs sde mang du sgro gas// lha drug pa skyes padar ma la// lcags stag khra bo'i lding sdu/ra zhes// brtsobya'i khams kyi dgra stag nas// gyen bkan 'thab pa'i rtsis 'bo lnga //91

srog gi mda' mo chag ma chag/ stag ral 'khor gsum shor ma shor// ral gri'i dbal so brdul ma ///shāstu/ rwarngo/'i rwa//da de// rwasdo/srobardul// nga rta dang bral mabral// dpa' 'thab rte/wangasamangs// lha dang ga gi del dkar na// slog gi mda' mo ma chag pas//dpa'atsho/byi ga'u brtan//smyo la ri mo bkra bayin// nagata g.yuladu song na shi/ rang dang spun la ma/ 'ar bas//srog k+ṣiṃ nye'u 'ag gri kha bsgyur// lha gas del dkar na byes brgyud dar// 'ar gsum rked nas la bas//stag chas lusari brgyan ༵ ༵༵//snyo/sdudosapadar gud 'akau // stag ral gag shulha grwa nyams pas// mirabs ra ga////de ༈dbang 'darkaranapha zhad/dro//ras dbalas mkhasalabag/ yong phyugs kyidaslobs / nagatagayangagiga'akheb //gastogayuzas noragang stosache//r+shardomacho bengadabang thang spel//lhadrung shel desadakaraka ring brgyud 'pho//dpa' sne'ithab ra ma stongs pas//dgra bo stong gi gral 'go 'dzin//nag nadapa' rtsalagalas zhum//kha yi sgra che khong nas 'dar//dgra brub dgra bzlog drag dbang zhu// lhabadun pa mo btsun bzang mo la//gnamacidamar r+yā lding sgor zhes///bya'i khams kyi ma byi nas//gyen bgrang 'thab pa'i rtsis 'go lnga // daradakar la'u zag ma zag/ g.yu chung lung thag chad ma chad// dpal gyi nyi mnub ma nub//srid gyichu mig bskams ma skam// pang nas bu chung shor ma shor// lha dang po nyog gi deladakar na// daradakar sham bu ma zag pas// tshe ring bus phan ci byas 'grub// nag na tshe la bar chad r+sā//mas gyi sri langs sri la ngan//srid gso tshe 'dzin 'khor pho 'dogs//5 lus rdil dkar na na tsha med// bla g.yu'i lung thag ma chad pas// bu tsha lnga'am dru/ sna dbang // kau na sdo dang khyo la ngan// nad 'byung tshoms pa'i las mi 'grub// lus bskyed bas dang gtsug gar 'an// ༈dbang deladakar na pha ming dar// dpal gyi nyi ma ma nub pas// mnga' thang longs r+sā rgyas te bzangan/nag nadapal gyi g.yang mtsho skam//nor wo che zhing gnyen gyis sdang //sbyin pa gtong zhing sto sri mnan// 5 rlung shel dkar na snyan graX che// srid gyi chu mig brdol bas na// bsam ba

'grub cing mi kha byams// nag na nyes med khaskudagasa'abyungan/ khyim pa 'pho zhing mag skud ngan// rlung bskyed brtson la dgra grub bya// 5 smi del dkar na rig brgyud 'phel// ma pang bu chags khye'u 'khrungs// nag na pang nas bu shor bas// ba tsha gso dka' mya ngan 'ongan/ srid gzungs 'dzugs shing bla bsku bya// lha brgyad pa byis pa gzhon nu la// nor bu 'od 'bar lding sgor zhes// brtsobya'i khams kyidagra stags nas// gyenabagrangabathab pa'i cisa'i11 lngaka/ g.yung drung rabazhig ma zhig/ gser nya skam du jon ma thon// gos chung chu yis khyor ma khyor// gzhon nu'i rtsed ra stongs ma stongs//se mda' se gzhu chag ma chag/ lha dang wa yengag gi rdel dkar na// g.yung drung ra ba ma zhig pas//byis pa lcams dral dge zhing bde// nag na bar chad sdug bsngal 'byungan/ dpal khyi bu ros khengs pas na// byis do/na chung gto tshe dbang zhu// 5 lus del dkar na gser gyi nya// skam las ma thoni kha dog legs// lus la nad gdon mi 'byungabazang // nag na gser nya tshad pas gdung // ma dang sru mo'i 'dre gnod pas// thon mchod sri mnan mchod den cigs// lha dbang del dkar na zas nor 'phel// bo sa chung chu yis ma khyer bas// byis pa lha dang srung mas skyob// nag na za cadag ser thang ral// bu chung shing gi ngo ldang bas// gos sbyin bya zhing chung sri mnan// 5 rlung shel dkar na byis payi// rtsed ra ma stongs lha gral tshud// 'gro ba gzhan gyis mngon par bstod// nag na bsten pa'i lhayis bcani// mya ngan shi chad 'byung dogs pas// khrus dang lha gaskusnal lam 'phrang bcos// ༈sme rdel dkar na bla masnur brtan// se mdang me gzhu ma chag pas// rkyen ngan bar chad garoston nas bral//nag na byis pa'i sku mkhar 'gyel// tshe dang bla la nyen che bas// tshe dbang tshe mdo dgra bzlog bya//༈ dgu ba na chung gzhon nu la// mthing gi rma bya'i lding stor zhes// brtsobya'i khams kyi ma'i khyi nas//gyen bgrang 'thab pa'i rtsis 'go lnga // bal skud 'phang ra stongs ma stong // mthing gi lu ma bskams ma bskam// ha pho sad gyis khyer ma khyer// dngul dkar me long g.yang ma g.yang// g.yu yi lcang pho phying ma phying // lha dang po srog gi der dkar na// bal skud 'phang ra ma stongs bas// tshe ring srid 'phel nad gdoni med// nag na tshe yi dmyu thag chad// tshe rta tshe 'gugs tshe g.yang gaskusna// ༈lus ldel dkar na lus nad med// mthing gi lu ma ma bskam bas// ma sring bu yis phan 1—gas bzang 93

nag na nad gyi zug rgyar mnar// bu sring ma la dar gur 'byung / lus bsgyur byur 'bud gto bcos bya// lha dbang rdel dkar na dbang thang 'phel// ha lo sad gyis ma khyer bas// rgyan gos lang tsho sminate bzang // nag na dpal khyim byur gyis phub// bu norayul mi khyim mtshes ngan// gzungs sde sgroṭa la god sri mnan// 5 rlung rdel dkar na dngul dkar gyi/ melongabatsa'agayasamakhasgrib pas// yulamakhar rnyed cingakun gyis byams// nagan mikhaciltarabakhrid// mdang phyi rdzosring ringangan//rlungabaskyed mar mebargya rtsabasags// ( sme shel dkar na dman khyo dge/ g.yuyi lcang pho ma phying bas// bla tshe brtan cing srid rgyud dar// nag na rgyun ring nad gyis thebs// 'khor g.yog mya ngan 'byung ba'i ngo // bon chos sgrol ma sbrag ma 'don// lha bcu ba bran g.yog las byed la// mi 'gyur gze bzhi'i lding sgor zhes// shar stag sgo 'brug nub bya dmar// byang phag mi 'gyur gzer bzhicad// de yang zhib par brtsebya ni// stag rta khyi gsum thongags gyi stag/ byi 'brug sprel gsum ma yi 'brug/ bya glang sprul gsum pu yi bya// phag lug sku1sa gsum khams mthun phag/ de nas du lon gyen bkan dang // brtsibyas 'thab pa'i rtsis 'go lnga // mda' lnga gzhu gcig shor ma shor// rje blon bka' chad byung ma byung // pho khyim mun pa 'thibs ma 'thib// byur gyi gnya' shing khyar mi khur//'bangs kyi za thang 'gas/sa ma 'gags// lha dang wa 1ga gi del dkar na// mda' gzhu lag nas ma shor bas// bran gyis phan thogs tshe yang ring // nag na rje yi bka' dang 'gal// g.yang nyams tshe srog chad ngoyin// tshe 'dzin gdags shing bran g.yang 'bod// lha gas del dkar na ci byas 'grub// rje blon bka' chad ma byung bas// lus la nad med bran rigs bge/ nag na nad dang sdug bsngal 'byung // kha smras ngo yin lha srung mchod// lha dbang rdel dkar na pho khyim la// mun pa ma 'thib zla 'od shar// zas nor longs spyod 'dzoms pas bzang // nag na bran nor gang stongs che//rta phyugs nor la god kha 'ong // khrus dang gser 'od g.yang len bya// 5 rlung rdil dkar na kha smras med// byur gyi gnya' shing ma khur bas// rgyal gyis mi bcadan 11na gyis byams// nag na mya ngan mi thegs khur// mi kha dgra brub lam 'phrang bcos// 5 smi del dkar na don dang ldan// 'bangs gyi za thang ma 'gag pas// bran 'khor 'byor ldan bla tshe brtan// nag na nod god longs spyod dbul//94

bran gyi bya kun nas 'gal// lha gsol phywa skor gtong ma gtong // lha bcu gcig yul mkhar bang mdzod la// gser phag ser po'i lding sgor zhes// bcingabya'i khams gyi dgra phag nas// gyen bkan 'thab pa'i rtsis 'go lnga // yul la 'pho skyes byung ma byung // mkhar gyi rtselha yar ma yar// sgyed pu slongaro ṭa byas ma byas// gser ka g.yu gdung chag ma chag/ pha zhing mis tho btsugs ma btsug/lha dang po srog gi del dkar na// yul la 'pho skyes ma byung bas// pha gzhis bu yis zin te bzang //nag nayul kha gyes pas ngan// sa bdag glu gnyan gnod pas na// sa bdag mdos dang klu bum 'dzugs//༈ gus del dkar na rtselha dar// mkhar dang bdag po mi 'bral bzang // nag na mkhar la dme grib phog/ rmang gzhi zhig gam mi rabs chad// lha sel sgra bla'i dpang bstod bya// lha dbang rdel dkar na skye bu ni// slo 'doṭa ma byas bzang ba ste// thab la mar khu'i mtsho mo 'khyil// nag na zas skom bcud 'chor bas// thab 'og 'dod 'gyur bum ba sba// 5 rlung del dkar na gser ka dang //g.yu gdung ma chag yul khams brtan// nad dang mi kha med pas dge/ nag na khyim sde zhing sa brdol//sa bdag snying bsdums rlung gso 'dzugs// 5 smi rdil dkar na pha zhing la// mi dang 'dre yis rtsod pa med// lo legs 'bru 'phel 'byung bas bzang // nag na zhing ngakyil bse rags gab// 'byu bcud mi 'phel phywa g.yang nyams// yul lha mchod cing sa g.yang 'be bas// lha bcu gnyis gser sku gas skam chas la// rin chen bum pa'i lding nyo ra zhes// bcingabya'i khams kyi 〈snags phag nas// gyen bgrang 'thab pa'i rtsis 'go lnga // gser gyi ri rab chags ma chags// g.yu yi mtsho snu 'khrugs ma 'khrug/ phra men bum pa gas ma gas// phywa g.yu'i mig thag chad ma chad// bgol zangs rbabatu 'gril ma 'gril// lha dang po srog gi shel dkar na// gser gyi ri rgyal khrigs su chaṭa // 1—na gyi nor gter da lta spyod// nag na skam nor nyams chags 'byung // 'gong po chags 'dre bkar bar bya// ༈ gus del dkar na g.yu yi mtsho// ma 'khrugs lus la rgyan gos ldan// nag na dpal gyi g.yang mtsho skam// byur 'bung nor lha sgrub sogs gces// lha dbang rdel dkar na longs spyod 'du// phra men bum pa ma gas pas// nor bu'i bang mdzod khengs te bzang // nag na dngu la phongs sdug bsngal myong // skam nor mi chags dbang bskyed brtson// lha drung rdel dkar na phywa g.yuyi//95

migazags chad grags snyan rgyas// snam nor spyad kyang zad mi shes// nag na rin chen gzhan la 'chor/dar dkar sgye'u rlung gis bus// rnams rgyalagazungs dang stobs chen 'don// ༈ gle sheladakar na 'gel zangs nyid// babatus 'griladakoranor phyogs// ma bsang na yang bang mdzod gang // nag na g.yang can nor shor bas// noradang yid tshang 'phel 'grib mngan/ bdudabazlog phywa g.yang drag po bslan//༈ bcu gsum rta lug phyugs gsum la// 'brong chen dar ma'i lding sgor zhes// brtsebya'i ma yi glang nas gyen// du len bkan 'thab cis 'go ga gyi ling gasrab bral ma bral// yo ma lagaya chad macad//g.yag rgod cid pa byid ma byid// lha 'bri gad las lhung ma lhung // g.yang mo bstar thag chad ma chad//dang wa yengag gi ral dkaran// gyi ling sga srab ma bral bas// rda bong phan stobes che bas bzangan/ nag na gyi ling rda la ngan// gu bo sogs gcade sbyin ni sgrub// ༈ gus del dkar na yo ma yi// lag pa ma chad rta sga 'phel// nag na rmig zlum mi chags pas// rta sri mnan cing rta gud thongs// ༈ dbang shel dkar na g.yang chags shing // g.yag shod cid pa ma byid pas// phyugs 'phel god khas 'byung bzangan/ nag na zhol po'i g.yang sar ngan// rtaṭa can mi gtong sgor gzungs 'don// 5 rlung shel dkar na g.yang dar nas// lha 'bri gad la ma lhung bas// phyugs 'phel mo ru 'phel te bzang // nag na phyugs sgab 'dre yis rlom// phyugs kyi dngos grub rjes 'debs bya// ( sme shel dkar na g.yang mo yi// bstar thag ma chad phywa brgyud 'thud// lha lug ra ba gang ba'i ltas// nag na g.yang mo'i ra ba la// gdug pa spyang kis 'che sder bdar// chung phyugs khrag mkhyenan nub doṭa gda'// chung glud gode sri mnan 11gas bya// de ltar gtsug la dam pa 'di// rgya nag dpyad lding bcu gsum mam//bal mo'i sding skor du graṭa pa'i// gnad kyi lag len bshad zin nyo// lha gzhan yang byes song mi yi ched// lha rgyal tshangs pa'i byes rtsis zhes// byes 'gro'i dung kyi bla ba dang // byes mi'i srog lus dbang rlung bzhi// gcade 'dral 'thab ste 'di ltarabartag/ mi 11ga zlas bcad byes 'chi 'am// dgra dang bsad bcad ngosang yode// lus bcad na 'am btson0la tshud// dbang bcad zas nor dgra jagayo//rlungabacad mdza' thothe/ bsgyanyenalode// brdzibyas zla srogaphar bcadasga//shi chad med pa mkhyogasapar 'khor//lus grogaga'aphrad na nad ngo sed// sbyong leṭa stobs ldan lus groṭa che// dbang thang grogaga'aphrad bza' 96

btung mode// rlung rta groṭa 'phrad mi kha byams// bla bos rang la rtsis thang che// lha sagani ma 'phrad bsam rgu 'grub// lus ma 'phrad na na tsha dathosan// dbang thang ma 'phrad jomang las rgyal// rlung rta ma 'phrad bor stor med// sa srog ni bu phyogs stongs pa na// tshe nyams bla 'khyams shi chad ngo //lus stongs tshong phamagagroṭa chung ngo // dbang thang stongs na za thang dman// rlung stongs bor storami kha sdang // lha me srog nang 'phrad phar 'gro ni// bag dro bsnad cing shi chad med// tshur 'ong dar tsam sems tsagayode// me lus nang 'phrad phar 'gro ni// dgra med groṭa che na tsha dkon// tshur 'ong zla gcig skad gsalasgyu sa// meyi dbang thang nang 'phrad na// phar 'a1 spungang che skyid sar bsdad// tshur 'ong yin na lam du zhuṭa// me rlung nang 'phrad phar 'gro ni// sdod sar stor brlag ma byung na// tshur la de ring song 'ong yin// lha sa srog nang 'phrad phar 'gro bshol// sdod sar don chung gyi nar nyal//sa lus nang 'phrad 'go nad 'byung // phyi thal tshong grogs rgyal pos byed // sa dbang nang 'phrad grogs chung la// don 'grub 'dra yang mi 'grub bo// sa rlung nang 'phrad 'gro na yang // 'dodadon miche rjod nathongaka/ tshong 1stogs the'u rang gis byed pas// dang po rgyal de tha mar pham// lha sgog lus dbang rlung bzhi ga yangan/ chu nang doni chung mgyogs par 'khod// shing nang nga phrad kyang 'khor ba mgyogs//lcaṭa nang 'phrad na phyi dal che// groṭa bzang dgra yis 'tshe ngo yod// zla ba sa khams phyi dal che// chu khams myur cadang ro na mi 'grub// me khams mkhyodaṭa 'a(4ra gang bsam 'grub// lcaṭa khams yun ring doni kyang dben// shing khams groṭa chung 'jiṭa pa che// de ldar sku ba'i byas rtsis so// ༈ gzhan yangasan lag gab rtsis la// byung ba'i dmag mi dar 'dzin rtsis// brdzibya'i ma yi 'brug sgyu ga nas//mar la du lone sgrub par bya// de nas yar la bco brgyad bgrang// de dang phan tshun srog gnyis 'thab// brtsobya tshur bcad 'ju thag chad// yar bcu bgrang dang dbang thang 'thab// tshur bcad rang nyid 'dre la bstongs// mar gyi bco brgyad rlung rta 'thab// tshur bcad sa yi rten phur phyungs//mar bcu bgrangadang lus 'thab pas// brtsobya tshur bcad srin pos nyos// de ltarangan 'dzoms gang byung ni// zlabacu tshun la rkyen 'ong bas// skyes dar dmaga'agro spang blang gyis// ༈ yang gcig mtshon cha'i skor 'go ni// brtsebya'i khams mthun rta thog nas// du lon thur sbub de nas yar// bco 97

brgyad bgrang soṭa gong bzhin bya// srog gis 'ju thag la sogs brtag/ tshur bcad mtshan cha'i ngar chag ste// yul la 'khruṭa pa 'byung ba dngan/ sku mkharadamags gis bsgor bsar// zhag bcu tshunas 'ur 'khruṭa dngan/ ra mda' ring brgyud ngosangayin// 'di ni kun la brtsorung ste// bza' tshang gtsobo de la bzungan/ lha lha'adre nyo tshong rtsizhes pa// 1 31ra rang gi groṭaspedas nas// du 'on mar sbub srog gnyis 'thab// de nas mar bdun lus gnyisa'ithab// tshur la ma gcad bzang ba yin// bcad na lhayis 'dre la btsongs// khyad par lcagasadagradar bdangan/ spar kha'i gnam sgor 'dzoms na ngan// ༈ snu ba|ra mayi71sa nasayar// du lon grangs la srog dang 'thab//de nas mar bdun lus gnyis 'thab// tshur bcad 'jiṭa soṭa gong ltara'adra// ༈ zhuṭa kyi gab tshe'i btsas rtsis ni//khoni thog bu mo btsas pa na// ma sgo bu snu sa bkag pa ste// phyis kyang bu mo skyo ba yin// bu modeyang nor sna za// mate ma shi'i bar dgatu// bu mo de la bu mi 'byungan/ khen thog bu btsas pha sgo bkag/bu de sum cur ma thebs gongan/ pha de sngon du 'jug pa yin// yang na pha de ma zhi'i bar// bu tsha skye ba mi 'gyur ro// gin la bu mo btsas pa na// ming gral sringagis 'phrog pa de// phyis kyang bu sa'abyung zhes bshad// de so ṭa rtsis phran ji sted pa// mtha'adag ba1de kyis mi langs kyangan/ lag len thebs shing gal che'i riṭa// mdor bsdus brjod 'dis 'dodadon 'grub// ces rtsis rig shes bya kun gsal las rgya nag dpyad lding bcu gsum gyi rabatu byed pa ste dgu ba'o// nag rtsis snang srid gsal ba'i me long las dpyad lding bcu gsum 'di leṭa bshad du mthong nas bkod pa'o// //98

brtse'idirasnangadapyad//shidusababashasagamababasan//sreg shel nag na tshe zad cing // lus del nag na lusatwar 'don// dbang rdil nag na zan grangs thebs// rlung del nag na rlung rta 'grib//khams nag khams kyi'adurabangathongaka/spyir stangs ldelanagatshebasod zad//de'adakuradus rina'achi zhesabs//sparacasogakyangageg phyinan//tshe da de min bar chad yin// srog gi rdil tshar nag pa na// shi kha bye bas chod dka' zer// srog gi rim grosang dag bya// lus kyi delatsharanagayan//shi mig gson la blta bsan//dur sgrimanan zhingadur lhagasol//dbang thang ralatshar nagayan// nor god 'ong bas kyang zer// phyedaspenal tshe lhag pho gnyis lus// dgong mo tshe lhag lo bzhi lus// nyi nub tshe zad soṭa su brjod//srod dus tshe lhag pho gcig las// sred chen tshe lhag zla drug zer// nam gung tshe zad dus babasayin// phyed yol tshe lhag zla ba gnyis//tho rangs tshe lhag zla ba gcig/ de ltar 'chi dus dag la dpyad// lhaganyis pa spar kha'i le len ni// shi lo'i skabs su babs spar brtag/ za 'i la shi na gos rdzas dngaka/ rta zhwa sha mar soṭa su nyose// chu brgal me las shing bcad lan// lus stode la sogs tsha nad 'byung // srog ni dkor bdag dam sris bcad// yugs sas nyes grib lha srung yal//spang mdog seradus bla tshe khyer//kha phyoṭa lto'am byang bltas shi/nub byang mtshams su bdud kyis bcad//ba phyuṭa gos dmar la sems chags// rnam 'joms thar mdo soṭa las bcol// 7khon la rdo slog shing gnyan bcad//yugs sa'i sha dmar zos pas lan// mkhar las mchod rten bshigs pa dang //nad ni lci 'thibs gzhogs g.yon na//srog ni sa bdag bdud kyis bcad// ro grib kyis ni lha srung yal//dgun dus bdud srin bla khyer bshad// phyoṭa ni / ༷༷ byang shar bltas// nor rdzas phyugs la sems

bya// (khyim) /khyim skyes ma ni zhing las dang / /khyim gsar 'dzin pa kun la bzang // (mong ) tshong pa dag la nyo tsho nga dang / /brtan par byed pa'i las kun rab/ (bi3)bikhyi la ni gzhan gaskud dang / /dug rjodar rtsub pa'i las rnams bya/ /dge legs dbang bskur rab gnas dang / /lha na gnyer bag ma la skusnags ngan/ /drag las 'grub kyang gdodang pa 'dzem/ /de yi spang blang sgrib shing 11gas/ /rgyas par dbyangs 'char nad bshad mod/ /'di ru nyer ma〈sna bya bde ba/ /snga cha sgrib tshul mdo tsam la/ /rdza dmar nang du rag 'gag bzhag/ /de nyid chus bkang de stongs su//phor ba bzhag las ra rog gi/ /snying rnying rab la de min na/ /gang byung snying dang mi'i lus la/ /bya 151

mgo bya dmaral khu can/ /phag nag ze dkar gur dkar phug/ /phyi cha mi nag bya mgo can/ /bya nag khyi nag gnyis bya la/ /gser 'gag nang du chu blug la/ /tho nga bzhina'ajug la de rnams kyang /nyi khyim gnas 〈snags bzhag ces kyangan /rang rang rgyu ba'i tsothogs la bstan// thun mong bsgu sa ka bsdus pa ni/ /phyag rdor sku 'am thang ka 'phyar/ /snang brgyad klog cing bsgog pa bya// 7 khyad par dbye ba'i byed pa las// (bkris) bkra shis la ni rgyas pa'i las/ /sngaṭa dang smod pa sman sbyor bzangan/ (bzhi) bzhi mdo la ni bram ze mchod/ /rgyal srid bya ba ba lang las/ /mtshun gtor la so/gas bya ba bzangan/ 9klu/ klu la brtan las bsad 'asgyu ga dang / /skal pa bzang po'i las rnams bzangan/ (mi) mi sdug pa la dge las dang / /mi bsad pa dang 'phyog pa'i las/ /skal pa bzang po'i las rnams dngan /mngon 'dod rgyas las dbang bskur bzungan/ 7 de ltar gza' chas skar sbyor byed/ /skar rtsis yan lag lnga zhes pa'i/ /'bras bu zhib par brjod zinato/ /brgyad pa brtsibya'i ming jog dang / /res gza'i khams bstun brtsobya ste/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag gson gzhis gyi//las kun 'di nyid shin tu gtso/ /de phyir 'di las gces par bzungan /desang legs sbyar yi ge'i grangs/ /lnga bcu wa da yig mkha' me ste/ /ka la 11gas pa nam mkha' yi/ /yi ge dgu dngashugo ca sku gas/ /rlung gi yi ge srin pu yin/ /me yig ra rkyang chu nyid la/ /u la 1—gas pa'iyi ge drug /sa la sogs pa sa yig drug/ gza' dang ming thog khams sbyar bar/ /mingasanga'aphul dang mgo can sogs///'phul ba'i dbus ma brtsegs pa yi/ /mgo can bzung la gza' khams bstun/ /nam mkha' 'byung ba bzhi yi masnar+shag/ /kun kyang 11gas su 'gyur ba ste/ /me rlung 'phrad pas las gsum 'grub/ /mnga' thang longs spyod ldan pa yin/ /rlung nang mdun ma'i las kun 'grub/ /me gnyis phrad pa drag las bzang / /sa chu kun gyi yid du 'ong dus kun skyid cing bkra shis byed/ /chu nang phrad pa phun sum tso gas/ /gtan gyi dge dang 'jam las bzang / /sa nang phrad pa dngos grub thob/ /dge dang 'jam langs bkra shis sku / /saza'ayi 'byung ba ming dgrar gyur/ /ngan pas zhi drag las kun spang / /ming — 152

de gza' yi dgra gyur na/ /drag las bzang kha gza' ming gi/ 11gas gyur maspyodagatu bshadapayin/ming yig gza' 11gas ngan pa yin/ /dgra phrad sa mes sdug bsngal byed/ chu drung 11ga thal ngan pas spangag /chu yis rlung las mi nusate/ sa yis me las de bzhin cas/ /rlung gis las ni mi nusate//nus med bya ba kun ྅stongs shig/ dgra ni sa dgra me yin la/ /me dgra chu la chu dgra rlung /rlung gi dgra ni sayin no/ /de ltar zhibatu brtag par bya// 7 zhar byung bla gza' bla ska ra yogs/ /bcu gnyis pho la sbyar ba'i tshul/ /'ogatu re'u mig lta bu la/ /'bras bu bla skar bya la 'grub/ /gshed skar la ni bgegs 'dul bzangan /bla gza' dar dusa'iphrin lasa'igrub/ ma 11gas gza' la cigang bzang / /srog gza' dge la bu gza' 'bring / /gshed gzar byol zhing dgra bo yi/ /bla gza' rgyud la gshed dar dus/ /mthu dang nus pa sprad na myur/ /bla sgog dbang skar ci yang bzangaka /ma groṭa skar ma dge ba de/ /bu 'bring keg bdud gshed gsum ngan/ /ma la btsas dus bla skar dngan /phrad na tshe ring 'gyur bayin/ /dbang skar phrad na tshe thung 'gyur/ /gshed skar dngani 'chi skar gcig dgu pa 'grub sbyor la sogs pa/ /bzang ngan 'phrod sbyor bco lnga rnams/ /re re gza' re 'phrad pa'i tshul/ /'og gi re'u mig ji bzhin la/ /'bras bu dge zhan 'dir baljade na/ /'grub sbyor bdun po spyir bzangayangag /dmigs bsal spang bya 'di ltar yode/ /nyi mar khang phug khyim de phung / /kra ba dmag jag kha nyes 'byungan /mig dmar 'jo phyugs phyir nyo ngan/ /lhag par bag byas khyom po'achi//phur bur shid byas mi g.yang nyams/ /pa sangs bag blangs bu mi 'byung / /spen par bu tshe phyir gtong ngan// (zung ) zung sbyor bdun la zhi rgyas dbang / /bzang zhing drag po'i las la 'dzem// (bdud)bdud rgyal dgra lha mchode pa dang / /dgra mnan la lostog drag las bzang // (grub) grubaganyis gal che'i bya ba spyi/ /khyad par bsnyen sgrub mchog tu bzangan/ (bkra ) bkra shisanyi mar dbang bskur dang //rab gnas lha gsol dge las bzang // ('phel) 'phel nyir yoston tan 〈snab pa dang / /chu 'phebs khron 'dru zhing las dge/ (chub) /chib nyi bdun 'di khrums ltod las/ /zung spyor da ni mtshungs 153

bzang las dge/ (mthun) mthun nyir bar bsdum gnyen bca gsags/ /phan bya'i las rnams thams cad bzang // (spyor) ྅stor nyir lha gsol ltas 〉thon dang / /dge las bzang zhing drag las ngan// (bdud) bdud nyir bya ba spyir ngan zhing / /yongs 'joms mthu gtad ngan byed bzang //('chi) 'chi skusnar mkhar las tshe sgrub sku1gas/ /las dang bya ba phal cher ngan// (mi 1de) mi phrod nyi mar ngan las bzang / /sman dang mthun sbyor phan las spang // (mi thun) mi mthunanyi mar ngan byed bzang / /bzang las phal cher ngan pas spang // ('jig) 'jiganyir bag ma lam zhugs sogs/ /bya ba spyir ngan ngan byed shis// (rlug) srig sbyor ram ni gtan spang 'dir/ /gal che'i bya ba thams cad dang / /khyad par gtar sreg spang bar bya// (rten 'brel) bcu pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye ched reg pa dang / /tshor ba srid pa len pa dang / /srid pa skye ba rga shi rnams/ /dpyid ra stag zla nas bzung ste/ /dgun ra glang zla bar rim sbyor/ /tshes la 'char tshul zhib pa ni/ /zla ba'i sgang nas sgang tshang bar/ /nyer brgyad nyer dgu sum cu dang / /sku gcig sku/ gnyis gang 'dug pa/ /brtag las rang rang khyim zla yi/ /re'u mig bzung la nyer brgyad skabs/ /bco lnga sum cu'i 'og gnyis dor/ /nyer dgu yong na sum cu dor/ /sum cu 'grig tshe bco lnga po/ /gnyis ka dkyus bzhin 'god pa dang / /so gcig so gnyis gang yod kyang //de'i grags rim brnan dad pa rtogs/ /'bras bu'i spang blang 'di bzhinate// (ma rig) ma rig pa yi nyi ma la/ /mchothod rten mkhar cig macesad sbyin dang / /zhing khang sa btsar la mabo lus bkru/ /bostos bca sku/na gnyer 'du long bzang / /mi chen mjal phrad mo 'debs dngan /gos gsar gyon pa ngan pas sgongs/ /don gnyer shar de bkra shis dge/ sgo ru rtsod phrad don mi 'grub/ /nubatu snying mi dga' ba'i gtam/ /cadas shing dosnan mi 'grub pa dang / /byang gi phyosnags phyin gtam snyan 1—sa/ /bu btsas 'o zla zhag dgu la/ /ma shikhoradangasmrab mngan /nye ba dang 'thab rtsod pa ldang / /sems sduga'akhrig la sred pa dang / /yig rtsis gtsug lag shes par byung / /lo ni brgyad cu mgacig 'tsho/ /tha ma 'du byed nyi 154

marabachi/ /bor stor byung na byang nasacangs/ /mini skra ngana'achama'i dga'/ /de 'bras shar phyogasasngag ring khyer/ /zhagadagu tshun la rnyed para'agyur/ /nad btab zla ba phyed tshun la/ /ma zhi de nas zhagagasum na/ /sku sa parabagyur bas gzab par gces/ /sgribaka'abyu lngar rgan mo'itshugazugs//phong bya'i rgyabatu shog bu'i/ /ma rig payi gnod pa dngan /chags chetams ngadagra la bsgyur/ /bya ba byisasprabaskyur bya zhingan /dkaragator mda'adaradakar podangan /'bru sna bcas pa sharadu 'dzugs//('du byed)'du byed kyi ninyi ma la/ /rigapayig bslab rgyan sprod pa/ /bag ma dge las khrus bya ba//khangapa bcigadangatshogisa'ikru ba/ /dgra ro tshar gcade las rnams bzangan /mar+shasna bkrus gos gsar gyon bta/ /nadadang tho buraye'abroga'ongan /don gnyer shar phyin nor rnyed cingan /bde bar sdog la stor phyinan/ /mya ngan sangs shinganyes med sdog/ /nubatu btsal ston zas rnyed cingag /byangadu bsam pa'idona'agruba'agyur/ /btsas na pho zla zhag brgyad la/ /tho bur ma shi phyug por 'gyur/ /spyan gnyis nadadakon tshe ring zhingan /grogs mang gyur kyang tshangs par spyod/ /mkhas pa bzo rigs shes pa dar//tshespen brgyadacu rtsagaciga'atsho/ /tha ma rnam shesanyi marabachi/ /nor stor rkun ma mdog ser skya/ /gos dug can pozhig gis khyer/ /rtagatu rkur dga' shar phyogs songaka /norade rang dang mi 'bral pho//nad thebasanyin bdun ma shi na/ /de nas zhag 11 gsum na 'chod /sgrib na bag byer rdza mkhan gzugs//darabasasnadang mda'adar ser/ /steng 'phyar phye mar gsur btang thug/ (rnam shes)rnam shes nyi ma rten bzheng ba/ /dbangabaskur sgrub mchod bya bdangan /smanadapyad mchod sbyinadagrabadul mo/ /grong khyer gzhomadang lha sa gsar rgyan/ /'du long bag ma rgyal sar bsgo/ /mge bkrusayid du 'ong la bzangan /lus bkrus ngang pa 'byung bas ngan/ /don gnyer sha ru nyon mongs shingan /rdzo ru nyes med nub rtsod dngan /byangadu phyi nad nor rnyed gyur/ /bcas na pho zla zhag lnga la/ /smo bur ma shi spro ring zhingan mkhas shing nga rgyal che ba dngaka /sdig dga' tshig sgrub dpa' zhing dbul/ /byang sems chung bar 'gyur bayin/ /drug cu caganyis 'tsho ba dngan /mtshon gyis ming gzugs nyi mar 'chi/ /rtsor 155

na rkun ma rang khyim mi/ /ser skya 17ngas chung zhig gis khyer/ /gzhan la khas mi len bas rnyed/ltaradi kha nad kyis btab pa na/ /nyi ma gsum lngar ma shi na/ /de nas zhag bdun brgyad la'iḥṭā/ /sgrib na rdza la sprel gzugs bajo sa/ /khethong du blto ga sngags brdzangs byas la/ /smana'abru sna bcas tham gsum cha/ro ra/ /bskyal la dar dmar gnam la 'phyar// (ming gzugs) ming gzugs kyi ninyi ma la// bkra shis bajodi dang skra sen 'breg/ dkar ཿthos 'jal len bla ma mjal/ /'jigs lasto phreshu pa sman rjodar bzang / /ma1— bkrus skra dkar lus bkrus na/ /gnyen skrag 1—sa lhune myur mdzad dngan /don gnyer shar dpal sgor bsam 'grub/ /nubatu mi rnyed byang stor rmongs/ /bcas na lo ni bcu gnyis dngan /zla zhag drug la ma shi na/ /nad nyunga'atsho dkon ldang ba mngan /buyin mi'itsho rtag 'jigs mngan /gtum zhing nga rgyal tshe smad phyug/ /chung ma gsuma'ade tshong gis 'tsho/ /tshe myo brgyad cu cagacig thub/ /gcong gis skye mched nyidamar 'chi/ /nor stor rkun ma spun gnyisa'ad//gcig ni bzhin mi sdug pa dngan /bkrag nag lag pa bzo baspend/ /zhag spro nyi shu gcig nas rnyed//nad thebs nyi ma gsum mam lngar/ /ma shi de nas bdun nas 1—la/ /brgyad par thal nas sku sa mi 'gyur/ /sgrib na bag phyer mnyan pa dngan /lha bze'i gzugs bcos ngar sman 'byungan /sna dang dkar gsum mnga' dar sngo / /sgor bstan sgos dkar dud pas thub// (skye mched) skye mched rgyal sa bya ba dngaka/ bag ma bsgog rim rten bzhing ba/ /rgyal po khrus byed grong khyer bzungan /dge las gter sped mgo bkrus na/ /gzi brjid gos rgyan mdzes 'gyur bzang / /khyim du zhugs nas slar —— 'byung dngan /gzhan la phyag bya sdig pa'i las/ /lus bkrus pha ma skrag pas ngan/ /doni gnyer shar dzhadu don rnyed cingan /rtso ru dpal phradayidadaga' la/ /nubadang byang du re ba rdzogs/ /btsas na pho brgyadasang na bcu/ /zla gsum nyin lngar ma dzin/ /ser sna che zhing nad mod la/ /dpa' zhing 'phongs la sred pa che/ /ltor 'du drug cu mabazhi 'tsho/ /rang khyim reg pa'i nyi mar 'chi/ /nor stor khyim mtshes mdog ser skya// gsum pa dngani mig che bas/ /chu 'gram grongaspend sa ru khyer/ /de 156

sar naganyisatson dgu/ /mgatu kha'iphyis35 rnyed mibargyur/ /nanga'aphags ma༄cu3thasaraslong//bsgrubaka phyedag mkhar bzos// dar smana'abri snadar ljang sgoms/ /gnam sbyar mda'acagagomadu bskyar///(reg pa'i) regapa'inyi ma shar bka/ /nubazog srogagacadacadapagacad/ /mnan bsreg drag rtsub las rnamasadangan/ mgo bkrus cade bskrung bas bzangan /bca dged lus bkrus pha ma sgrag/ gos gyon mdza' bos 'tshe bas ngan/ /galate gyon dge sgong gi/ /mdunas phyag byas gyon nabangam/ /shar song nad thebagasgo ru mdzes/ /nubatu ca codangangs skragayongan /byang༄ rnyed kyang yun ringa'agor/ /btsas na phodagu zhag lngadangan /spra bdagu lnga gsum grangasari/ /ma shi rtagatu nad kyisabadzin/ /bshes gnyen che la smra ba mkhas/ /1 ༄ge ldanazhingang gyal tshe/ /lag rku chos dga' phragatog che/ /phyug cinga'akhrig la sred padangan /soni drug cu cagasuma'atsho/ /chad pas rtsar ba'inyi marabachi/ /nor stor rang gi khyim mtshes la/ /skranagatams tsho pog cor che/ /ngo bstod rtagatuder gnas pa/ /yinateder btsugs zhinatu bston/ /bsgongs m+bi bzhi'ade lhang gzhan du/ /nor la'athab rtsod byed pa'abyungan /yun ring song nasangs tsam chod/ /nad thebasanyin gsum ma shi na/ /brgyadakasa'itsho la tshe ringa'agyur/ /sgribaka bag phyer sha ba dngaka /shasbyi can po'i gzugs bzos la/ /dar smana'abyu sna mi khayi/ /rdzas bcas phyir bskur dar smanadangan /rin chen lcags btsal rnams gtums la/ /rten gyi zhabs kyi'ogatu'ajug/ spang skyuraskur ba btang bas thub// (rdzar ba) tshor ba zhes bya'inyi ma la/ /mdza' bo phradadang chos byed pa/ /tsongadang chu brgal zhi ba'i las/ /'khor 'dudabang modakyila'akhor bzhid/ /zasator bsdu dngadage las bzang / /mgo bkrus skra byi lus bkrus na/ /yid mi bde zhing gos gyon la// dngang ngoyode pasa'adun par bshad/ /shar phyin mya nganasangs shing mgu/ sgo ru phyin na nad kyisabadebs// nub phyin shi chad gtam ngan thos/ /byangadu gtam snyanayid bde'abyungaka /btsas na lo brgyad zla ba brgyad/ /yang na zla gnyis zhag bcu gnyis/ /ma shi gzhan gyi bste/ /kur dngan /mchod pa'i gnas 'gyur g.yo rdzi

dga'/ /nang ljang 'byu nor phyug pa dang / /bzo mkhas chung ma gnyis dang ldan/ /tshe'am drug cu tham pa 'asnung/ /rang bas sred pa'i nyi mar 'chi/ /stothor na kun ma lamakharingaspenangan /khyi ni rkang lag nag dzoḍa la/ /lus khra phyi nas 'brangs pas khyer/ /zhag wasto ra gcig la rnyed 'gyur/ /nad 'a'o gnyin lnga ma shi na/ /dgur ljang bcu la gsos par 'gyur/ /sgrib na zan gomanga' mkhan gyi/ /gzugasabarā 'byu sna gri chung dang / /mda' dar lhan cig steng du 'phyar/ /gu gul dad pa btang bas thub// (gid pa) srid pa'i nyi mar bag ma dang / /nor rdzas bsdu dang nor dpus bsgyur/ /tshong byed 'du long dge ba'i las/ /mo 'debs myur spang las rnams bzang / /spro sa slon tigatu 'grub nayangan /de nyin bathosna bar mi bya zhingan /malhatho bkrus skra byi lus bkrus na/ /'jigs pa tshe zhing shar phyin na/ /dar+shasnas pa bskyed cing rdzo ru phyin/ /nor rnyed mya ngan phran tshegs 'byungan /nubatu shi chad gtam thos shing //byang du phyin nayid mi bde/ /byis pa lo dgu zla ba lnga/ /zhag po gsum dang bcur ma shi/ /grong khyer gyi ni dpon du 'gyur/ /bu tsha mang la 'ostongs spyod che/ /nad dkon gzugs bzang dgra srogs mngan/poni brgyad cu rtsabazhi 'tsho/ /dug gis len pa'i nyi mar 'chi/ /1—ra stor rkun ma nub phyogs yongan/gzugs bzang 'phongs pa'i mi zhig ste/ /rkang lag nag po'i khyi yi bdag/ /der babs de thabs rnyed par 'gyur/ /nad thabs brgyad la ma shi na/ /bcur 'tsho de la ma gso sa 'chi/ /sgrib na casnag bu 'dode spyod bris/ /de ni 'jag ma'i mgal bar bcug/ 'byu dang sna dang mnyam byas la/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyal ba dang / /dar dmar gnam 'phyar tshil dud btang // (len pa) len payi ni nyi ma la/ /sman sbyor dgra byed pho nya gtong / /gzhan gyi bud med la bgrod dang / /kha spu 'breg dang mi smra bzang / /malhas bkrus skal pa bzang ba dang / /lus bkrus caster rnyed bzang pa yin/ /gzhan ma gang brtsams 'bras bu med/ /gos gyon tshe thung phan mi thogs/ /shar song 'jigs shing rdzo ru mdzes//nub tu cung 'jigs byang bsam 'grub/ /btsas na zhab / dgu zla ba gnyis/ /41 brgyad dgu la ma shi na//lta bar mi sdug sems chung zhing / /gting ring mdza' bo'i gzugs kyi ni/ /g.yo r+bhed la dga' 'dod 158

chags che/ /tshul khrims 'chal zhing pho drug cu/ /cabazhi'itsho zhing tha ma ru/ /srid pa'i nyi mar chu'am mdzes/ /rangagisaladu 'chi bar 'gyur/ /nor stor shar yong mi gnyis yod/ /nor phyir gnyis po ba phyogs 'thab/ /nges par rnyed para'agyur bayin/ /nad phog nyin brgyad ma shi na/ /bcur sos der kyang cung zad la/ ma shi ba ni 'tsho ba yin/ /sgrib na snam steng chos shig bzhag/ /nas dkar bre gang steng du ni/ /mar me mdun du sprod spar thug/ rkesrod pa'i/ sred pa'i nyi ma shar ba na//bud med mdza' bo bsu ba dang / /gzhan yang las kun 'grub 'gyur zhing / /mgo bkrus bzang dang bca' ba rnyed/ /lus bkrusaying 'ong mdzes par 'gyur/ /gos gyon mdzes kyang 'go mi bya/ /'thab rtsod bya ba 'di la sgongs/ /shar song don med 'jigs dang phrad/ /lto ru ci bsam thams cad 'grub//nubatu 'jigs che byang nor rnyed/ /btsas na nyin dgu zla gnyis sam/ gsum dang lo dgur ma shi na/gzhan gyi chung mar 'khrig pa sred/ gnyid chung gasgu bco dmag dpon 'gyur/ btsan phyug bzo yi gnas la mkhas/ /chung ma gnyis ldan drung du 'asnur/ /tha ma skyes pa'i nyi ma la/ /mtshoni gyis gzhanaskuspyal dgatu 'chi/ /'di la nor stor shar nasasku/ngas/ /g.yeng bag che zhing sbyang ba yi/ /bshes gnyen che ba zhigayinate/ /de nyid su la blo mi gtod/ /ring mor song nas nang nyams rnyed/ nad 'phog nyi ma gsum dgu la/ /ma shi btas sos bar 'gyur// /sgrib na zan la chang 'thung mi/ /gzugs bzos spang ma 'bru sna dngaka /dar dang rin chen gos nag kha/ /gang dang shug shing 'phyar bas thug/ (skye ba) skye brwasgo ni nyi ma la/ /bswārtog rim khyim bsdongs khang 'awidun 11gas/ /khyim bdag gi ni las rnams dngan/ rgyal dang sdudan po'i las rnams bzang / /masgosto bkru sa bkur sti rim gro rnyed/ /lus po bkrusakas mdza' 11 rnyed/ /1—sa lce na ring du mi gnas pa/ /bar+shatho bar mi bya shar du phyin/ /cathor rnyed rode kyis brlag par 'gyur/ /thesto ru gtam snyan nub nyes med/ /byang du cathor rnyed btsas pa na/ /nyin dgu zla dgu lo bcu la/ /ma shi rtag par nang bu can/ /phyugs dngasal 'khor mi skyong la/ /gzhan gyis mchode pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /drug cu 'tsho zhing rga shi la/ /chuyi gcadad pas 'chi bar 'gyur/159

/casar 47ra rkun ma mi gsum kyi/ /gnyis ni phyi mi gcig nang mi/ khungs phyi dal bus shar ba na/ /yun ring zhigata rnyed par 'gyur/ /nang 'phog nyin lngar ma shi na/ /brgyad la sos par 'gyur ba yin//sgrib na 'jim par byis btsas kyi/ /gzugs byas dar 'byu sman gyi sna/ /bal tsho na sgril la mda' dar lnga / /mnyamadu steng nas 'phyar ba dang / /bu ram gsur ni btang bas thub// (gi shi) gi shiyi ni nyi ma la/ /phyug po'i nor brku tshur blang rigs/ /mgo bkrus gos dang bza' btung rnyed//dedag bzang zhing mchod sbyin gtong / /bzlo khyad mo 'debs la sogs ngan/ /rtsode pa'i rigs rnam spang par
